'brog bsam gtan gyis brtsams/kan su'u mi rigs dpe skrun khang /
tshikhrotshodh+rirdajosgre/khrordoṭ+wāṃ/dro ༷ ༷ ma hūṃ hūṃ skuX/ /༷/ ༷5 ༷

sngon du brjod pa'i gtam/dmigs bu/shes yon pa'i skad cha yun ring la thos rgyu med song tshe/ mi rigs de ni nges pa ra'aphung la/ mi rigs de'i gzhon nu yar skyes dag ni 'phung ba las kyang rab tu 'phung nges na/ 'phung 'dre de ni sems kyi gshed du song nas kho bo cag sdod thabs med pa bzos/ de dang 'azel nas nan sems drag po zhig gis kun nas bslangs zhing/rig gnas yon tan gyis dbul ba shes na yang / 'u thug ste rang nyid ni bes yon pa gsha' ma zhig yin mdog gis/ spyi tshogs 'di'i rgyu 'bras kyi blo mig dang dasnyod thes kyi rgya ma yin khul mi byed ka med byung / da 'a'o men/spyir na lo ngo ba cu lhag gi dka' sdug las byung ba'i grogs po'i deb chung 'di la gsong por brjod 'dod pa'i skad cha re gnyis yi ger 'god pa'i kun slong ngam 'char gzhi zhig snga mo n+d+rasdu tram̐ da

rjo brjod pa'i tam/mod/ ci zhig ji ltar 'bri ba'i skor la yang yang bsams te da bar du nar 'gyangs byas song / do nub/ pha yul gyi 'ur 'ur 'tshub pa'i rlung dmar drag pos khang khyim 'dir 'od snang sbyin pa'i glog bzhu'i rgyun skud gcig dum bur bcad pas/ ring nas glog bzhu'i 'od snang la goms pa'i kho bor mtshon na/ khang mig chung tsār+sha— chung 'di'i mkha' dbyings hril por mun nag gi rngams shin tu stug——— 'di yang grogs bsam gtan lags kha gtad sa'i blun rmongs rjes rke lus kyi mun pa de dang khos drang bden lhad med kyis bstor cing sdu sde d+dha bskyangs pa'ispyome ro〉yi las dbang dang ci 'dra'i mtshungs ang /k+ṣe — 'di ltar dran gyin kho bos smag nag pa'i mtshan mo 'dir sdum sgron zhig gi 'od ngogs nas klog po khyed la〈me ro〉dang dam du 'brel ba'i gtam rgyud 'ga' 'chad 'dod/gtamazud dang po/nyi 'od kyi 'og tu/ mi bu kun gyi mthong lam shin tu gsal/'du long 'ur zing gis khengs pa'i khrom chen du ngo mtshar har gyis phyusngi rdi'i rjod mo mtshar po zhig lhags byung / 'bangs kyi gtsug tu

sngo brjod pa'i tam/bzhugs pa'i rgyal po chen po nyid sku rgyags pa sha tshil mer mer lto dbos pa brang kha ldir ldir gyis mngon byung / ha cang thal drags pa'i 'gying nyams dang bcas mngon byung / zer sgros la/ rgyal ———pos 'jig rten na dkon pa'i na bza' zla med cig mnabs yo da zer/ da dung shes rab kyi spyan mig dben tshe na bza' de mthong ba'i bsod nams med do skad/ 'di ltar rgyal po gos med dmar rjen du 'phyor nyams dod pos phar 'gro tshur 'ong byed/ sku blon tshos rgyal po'i rkub rjes nas gos 'dabs 'gyog pa'i tshul gyis phar 'gro tshur 'ong byed/ tag tag skabs der/ mi tshogs kyi dbus nas byis pa zhig gis skad gsang mthon pos‘‘rgyal pos ci yang gyon mi 'dug kho rang gcer bu redami’ zer/'di ni gna' gtam zhig red/ phal cher 'u cag gi pha mes tshos nga tshor 'di 'dra'i gna' gtam zhig bshad myong med/ de bas/ bdag gis gna' gtam 'di las khyed la bden pa smra ba'i snying stobs shig brjod 'dod pa yin/ spyir na nyi 'od kyi 'og tu mi bu tsho'i mthong lam gsal mod kyang / rgyal po nyid gcer bur rgyu dus sus tram̐~X rji ma

sngo brjod pa'i tam/grags/ smra bcad ngag bsdams kyi sbyor ba 'di ni ma gzhi nas nag nyes shig ste/ blun zhing rmongs pa'i rgyal po gcer bur rgyu dus ltad mor rol ba las ci yang mi smra ba 'di ya nga ba'i sdig spyod cig yin/de'i stabs kyis/ bdag gi bsam par nges pa don gyi yon tan pa zhig gi las 'gan ni g.yo 'gebs dang smra bcad dang 'khyog brjod min par/ mtshang 'byin dang rgyang 'bod dang bden par smra ba lags so/ /gtamar+ghad gnyis pa/sngon yul zhig na rtsis mkhan zhig yod pa rgyal po'i drung du song nas/ da lta'i nyin bdun pa la char ba zhig 'bab pa de'i chu kha la song tshad kun smyon par 'gyur ro zhes smras/ rgyal pos de thos nas rang gi btung chu'i khron pa'i kha legs par g.yogs nas char ba'i chu nang du mi 'chor bar byas/ 'bangasarams kyis ni de 'dra ma nus pas thams cad kyi kha la chu de song bas kun kyang smyon par gyur/ rgyal po gcis pu sems rnal du gnas nas bldad/den+d+ra sdil tram̐ kun gyi bsam tshul brjod tshul dang / rgyal po'i bsam

sngo brjod pa'i tam/tshul mi mthun par song bas thams cad kyis rgyal po la smyon pa zhes smod pas/ mthar rgyal po 'u thug nas chu de btung bas kun dang mthun par gyur to/ /'di'ang gna' gtam zhig red/ spyir na smyo ——— chu kha la ma reg pa'i rgyal po'i rig pa shin tu gsal te/ smyon par gyur pa'i 'bangs mi kun gyis mgrin gcig tu‘‘rgyal po smyos 'dug’’ ces 'ur rgyag pa'i skabs de la'ang / rgyal po'i shes pa khral khrul 4 dang rig pa ldab ldib ga la yin/ 'on te/ smyon pa khri phrag gis —sne rub pas rgyal po nyid spa bkong la dpa' zhum/ 'u thug thabs zad kyis spyo chu mi 'thung ka med bzos/ brgya la/ ‘‘smyon pa brgya stong khri 'bum kha mthun kyang khungs btsun du 'gro rgyu ci yang med la ’(dge chos kyi tshig)bden lugs ni nam yang bden lugs rang yin pas/ shes yon pa gsha' ma zhig la mtshon na nam yang smyo chu mi 'thung ba'i dam tshig cig nges par dgos pa ji skad du/ dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis/ blun po rang gi rjes su mi 'brang ya nga / /rang nyid blun po'i rjes su mi 'brang ba/ /'di ni mkhas pa'i dam tshig dang po ste/ /srog la babs kyang 'bad pas srung brwa ñcārji/ /

sngo brjod pa'i gtam/zhes gsungs pa ji bzhin no/ /gtamazud gsum pa/de yang gna' snga mo snga mo zhig ste/ spyi lo'i sngon gyi399lo'i nyin zhig la/ gna' bo'i ke ri se rgyal khab kyi a then si grong khyer dzā6 du/ mtshan la so khi ra the zhes gsol ba'i mtshan nyid rig pa ——— mkhan zhig la/ blun rmongs kyi rgyab rtsar 'grengs pa'i sku drag tshosabye ‘‘gzhon nu tshor ngan skul dang a then si'i lha la brnyas pa'i’’nag ༵ ri nyes bsnyad btags nas srog chad bcad/ nyin der/ khong rjadzo gis btson srung gis bskyal yong ba'i dug chang bzhes rjes 'chi kha ma — de la glo bur du skad ngag 'jor 'dzer gyis rang gi slob bu ladzikhu le tho/ nga tshos khu le phe o zi la bya pho zhig bskyis pa'i skyin pa de cis kyang sprod dgos/ brjed mi rungami’zhes gsungs rjes/ rlabs chen gyi mi bu des sbyan zung gtan du btsums/thengs dang por gtam rgyud thung thung 'di tshar gcig bklags rjes/ kho bo gting mtha' bral ba'i bsam gzhigs kyi garjing6 lad brdzangs shing / sems kyi ci zhig rnam pa drug tu g.yos

sngon brjod pa'i tam/byung / ci zhig la don dam gyi shes yo na pa dang ci zhig la bla na med pa'i mi gzhi zer ram/ dgung lo bdun cur so na pa'i bgres po 'di'i 'chi kha ma'i skad cha tshig gcig po 'dis yo da tshad la lan ———gas la por sbyin 'dug bdag gi bsam par/ yon tan pa gsha' ma zhig yin tshe mi gzhi lhad med cig dgos pa 'di thams cad kyi rmang dang yod tshad kyi gzhi yin par sems so/ / /klog mkhan lags/ gtam rgyud dag 'di ltar brjod tshar song / bsam gtan lags kyi〈me ro〉'di lha chos rig gnas shig gi khyim phugs nas mi bu'i rtsis thang dang 'tsho gnas/ bde sdug gang rung gi slad du 'bar nges pa'i me kha dron mo zhig gi son du smin tshe/ kho'i snag shog gi so nam gyi las 'dir gser mdog gi 'bras bus dud pa cis ma yin/ 'on te/ rtsom pa po'i dungs zhen rgod po'i srab kha grim lhod kyis phyogs lhung gi dkyu sar brgyugs pa'i cha yang yo da srid pas/ deb chung 'di'i legs nyes rin thang la klog mkhan nyid nas tshad gzhal ba shin tu gal che'o/ /gzhan yangaṭ+wāṃme ro〉'di'ang rig gnas gsar pa zhig gis bltams pa'i rjisaḍi sbyo'i

sngo brjod pa'i ma/khye'u zhig yin phyir/ kho bos kyang thog mar gtam rgyud 'chad pa nas dbu brtsams pa yin la/ gtam rgyud de dag la nges shes rnal ma 'drongs tshe/ khyed kyis〈me ro〉zhes pa'i deb chung 'di las bden pa smra ba'i byis pa zhig dang / smyo chu mi 'thung ba'i rgyal po zhig gzhan da dung dngul lor dang dbang shugs kyis thams cad la kha lo sgyur ba'i spyi tshogs khor yug cig nas u tshugs kyis srung zhing yong ba'i mi gzhi zhig mthong thub/ de dag mthong rjes/khyed kyis rang gi nang sems la byi dor thengs shig mi byed ka med yin kyang srid/spas pa/de yang / lo ngo bzhi brgya drug cu'i yar sngon la/ pho lan gyi gnam rig pa ku pher nyi khi si yis thengs dang por nub phyogs pa'i bsam blor bgrang bya chig stong lhag la dbang bsgyur pa'i‘‘sa'i go la lte bar 'dzin pa'i lta bar’’dogs slong byas shing / ‘‘nyi ma lte bar 'dzin pa'i lta ba'i’ srol phye ba bzhin/ bsam gtan sogs kyirji rdingaspra lte bar 'dzin pa'i rig gnas khor yug cig nas mi lte

sngo brjod pa'i tam/bar 'dzin pa'i rig gnas shig la rgyang 'bod byed pa yin la/gzhan du na btsan po khri srong lde btsan gyi ring la/ bod yu la 'dir‘‘sad mi’’zhes pa'i skye bo bdun rab tu byung nas dge 'dun pa'i sde thog mar btsugs/ bgrang bya stong phrag 'das pa'i de ring bod mi'i blun rmongs mun 'thom dang 'dod chung chog shes/ nyam chung nus med/ bag 'khums rjes lus kyi bag chags rnying rul la mtshang 'byin dang phyir rtog dogs slong dang dgag sgrub kyi snying stobs chen mor dpyod shes dang blo mig dpung du sbran pa'i skye bo dag ni bdag gis bod pa'i phyis byung gi sad mir 'dod cing /khong cag ni dus rabs kyis ded cing btsir nas bod pa'i rig gnas gsar pa'i do rar phud pa'i yon tan pa'i dngu nga 'ig dang /lha chos rig gnas kyi zhing khams nas 'tshar ba'i‘‘khyim pa skya bo'i sde’’thog ma yin par 'dod do/ /2004 3 10mtshan mor rkang tsha nas/— 9 —

dkar chag ji dbyangs can mar bstsal pa'i snyan ngag (1) cirine byis sgrung zhig gi smad cha/ (10) 4rdo pha yul gyi‘‘mi ma yin’’ (14) —ci/ ri bong cal 'drogs kyi bu rgyud/ (17) 4’mibaden pa bdar ba'i mchid/ (22)dus su babs pa'i bgro gleng / (26)las byed pa mgon med skyabs med 'ga'/ (32)par len sgyu rtsal dang gzhan dag (36)sred/ (39)pho ste1 ga (40)kha ba'i me tog (43)'brog dgon gyi slob chung / — 1(tram̐8)

da ra chagad snyigs sgrug pa'i bgres po/ (55)'u tshang gi u tshugs/ (58)smra bsam brjod 'das/ (70)sha mchin pa'i steng 'og brje gi (71)glen pa rdzig rdzig (77)tsha rmugs/ (83)sgo byang dang zas tho (88)'dre nag po snying la rje bo/ (91)bar thag (98)sprul sku (102)mi rabs gsum/ (103)mtshan bzhud kyi zin tho/ (104)bla sprul 'ga'i skya ris/ (109)rta dze+enā zhig gi yid 'phrog gtam rgyud/ (113)

da rachasras chung la ched du gleng ba/ (116)tshwa kha ru bsgres pa'i sbal ba/ (121)sgyu 'phrul gyi mi yul/ (124) ci rī dpon chung zhig gi rtsa don/ (125) rkapha yu la gyi tha ga ba/ (128) ske ci 'khyol dka' ba'i mtshan mo/ (132) dge rgan/ (136)smag nag chung klad la 'thibs dus/ (138)rang yul las 'phros pa/ (144)bun bdag 'ga'/ (148)ngag gi rlabs phreng / (149)me dang 'brel ba'i gtam rgyud kha shas/ ru thar/ (185)mi ru 'greng tshul/ rdor byams rgyal/ (189)

dbyangs can mar bstsal pa'i snyan ngagarang gshis ne+em lo ltar snyi ba'i dred po ya ma brla 'gas/ /ya thod dpral ba yi me long rkang ba'i sen mor glan te/ /shes bya'i dngos grub re gnongs zhes gcam bu'i mug skad sgrog dus/ /zhe sems mer mer zhig byung ngam dri za'i na chung sgeg mo/ /lcags smyug zad po zhig ji bzhin rtsom 'bri'i lag char brtsis shing / /snag bum chag po zhig ji ltar yig 'bri'i nyer — 1 —

dbyangs ca sar bstsal pa'i ngamakhor dmigs tshe/ /yab chen tshangs pa yi pang du mchi ma sham sham gtor gyin/ /sdug yus than thun zhig gleng ngam ri bong 'dzin ri rteri pa'i sring chung / /kha/ grog ma nag chung ltar grim pa'i smyug thogs g.yo spro sems can 'ga'/ /1dze/ cwa — rta rnga'i nyag ma dang mtshungs pa'i rgyud skud phra mor zhugs nas/ /khyod kyi phrag steng du 'gos te tshul 'chos gsob glu len skabs/ /snying rje'i skyo shas shig skyes sam shes rab dpal gyi lha mo/ /d+ngha 2 wabos pa'i bdung rtsi yis bkren tshos klad skogs

dbyangs canamar bstsal pa'i na ngakhyod la bzed de/ /'khos zhan bran khol gyi lag zung mngon chung dal bur sring dus/ /khrom chen 'du 'god kyi gseb na mthe bong ker ker sgring ba'i/ /yul gyar mi'u thung dag dran nam rgya mtsho chen po'i sras mo/ /mig 'bras chu mig las sngo la mgo skra dung ltar dkar zhing / /sgyu lus shing skam bzhin rengs kyang gzhon nyams 'phyor bo'i sgo nas/ /snying gi dga' ma ru rol zhes khrel 'das mu cor zlo dus/ /lus sems tha dad kyi bgyi bar gting nas khong 'dzum shor ram/ /

'tsho ba'i ro mngar gyis phyug pa'i phun tshogs myong ba med par/ /rig pa'i ltag sgo ru 'tshangs nas ming skam cho lor sred tshos/ /myag myog ljan ljin gyi ham sems smon lam dar gyis g.yogs nas/ /khyod la 'bul rten du phul dus rul dri sna yis tshor ram/ /bstan bcos sprin lam gyi dbyings su rnam daphyod g.yu 'brug rtsen zhing / /'khor ba'i 'gal 'du yi gseng nas smyug rtse glog zhags 'khyugs te/ /khrag dang rngul chu yi bcud kyis snyan ngag sbrang — 4 tram̐r 'be+ebs tshos/ /

dbyangs ca mar bamyul pa'i na ngarmad byung skyed tshal re bzhengs dus khyod rang sems 'gul thebs sam/ / rnying snyigs mkhregs 'dzin gyi 'ching zhags rtogs sad me yis bsregs shing / /lha bkur klu mchod kyi lcags sgrog rmongs 'joms thog gis bzhus te/ /rnam dag rang dbang gi ched du 'jigs bral dpung ru spran tsho/ /kla klo'i gshed tshogs kyis bskor tshe bzod dka'i zug rngu skyes sam/ /snyan 'jebs pi wang gi 'gyur khugs sems kyi gsos su 'jo ched/ /rna ba krong krong du gtad nas lo ngo dgu la nyan yang / / — 5 —

byangs ca sar basprul pa'i ngakhyod kyi g.yas g.yon dang mdun rgyab bskyar bzlas chos glus khengs pas/ /'ur zing za zi yis gtses te kho bo mgo yu 'khor byung / /mi yi she mong ni stor te nor srung rnam thar bskyangs nas/ /sgra dbyangs lha mo mchog mkhyen zhes blo gros mug skyob rgum pa'i/ /col chung zog po tsho'i dkyil nas bdag sems gdung bas gzir te/ /bgrang bya bcu grangasku kyi yun la gnyid kyi bde ba bral song / /shes mdzangs gter mdzod kyi dpe khang tshu ri'i — 6 tram̐gram nas bskyur te/ /

dbyangs ca sgor bstsal pa'i nga'akhyag bsil mun 'thibs kyi ke'u tshang pha ri'i rgyang nas 'tshol gyin/ /bsnyen sgrub bzlas brjod la 'bad de yon tan 'thob par re ba'i/ /bus pa 'ja' 'dzin gyi bzhad gar khra chung mig la 'tshe ba/ /'jam dpal shes rab kyi ral gris rmongs mun thengs dgur bzhar zhing / /mtsho byung rgyud mangs kyi dbyangs rtas ram bu lan brgyar btegs te/ /smra mkhan ne+e tso yi 'khor 'bangs cho 'phrul mthu yis bskyed kyang / /ngag rig khyung chen dang bshibs na phra rab rdul las chung ngo / /

byangs ca sar bcul pa'i ngabag yod tshul ldan gyi lha yul mi las ring du gyes shing / /rang bsam bdag gces kyi mi gshis lha las logs su gyar bas/ /mi yi rtsom rig gi kha phyogs lha yis gtan khel byas na/ /ra sug lug sbyar gyi brtsams chos klog mkhan ci tsam yod dam/ /yid 'phrog 'char yan gyi ngag rgyun rtog bzo'i son du smin zhing / /dga' skyo chags sdang gi 'tsho ba tshor 'du'i phabs su ltems kyang / /tsan dan sol ba ru btang nas khe tshong las la zhugs na/ /— 8 n+d+ram sras bang mdzod las 'gongs pa bzhad gad

dbyangs can mar bstsal pa'i ngargyu las ma 'das/ /'o 'dzin ldem ldem du g.yo bzhin mdzes pa'i ———gar zhig 'khrab zhor/ / rtelag mdzub lhug lcug tu 'gul gyin snyan pa'i hūṃ gdangs shig khrol dang / / rmi dungs sems nying bsdus kyis mtshon pa'i snyan ’ ngag dbyangs su gyer nas/ /khyod la gsol ras su bstsal chog tam bu ra yi mdzes ma/ /

byis sgrung zhig gi smad cha/brdzun gyi tshig rnams brjod mi bya/ /brdzun gyi tshig rnams brjod byas na/ /myur bar gzhan gyis shes 'gyur te/ /dper na byi la'i brdzun tshig bzhin/ /da waṭ+wāṃskye bo gso thigs〉las/byi las ske yi dril bu de/ /lag tu bzung nas g.yugs pa na/ /sngon gyi de las mchog go zhes/ /byi bas phyag 'tshal skor ba byed/ /— 10 —

bka' srung gnyan po nga yin zhes/ /snyan mchog dung dkar g.yas 'khyil gyi/ /dpe byad bzang bo bstan pa'i tshe/ /snyan grags dpag tshad khri ru khyab/ /stod kyi rdza ra ser chung gis/ /me tog phreng ba'i skyes btegs te/ /ri gsum 'gro don skyong ba'i phyir/zhabs kyi pad mo 'god dgos zer/ /smad kyi bra ba srug ril gyis/ /lo tog 'bru yi bcud bsnams te/ /lung gsum chos la sgyur ba'i ched/ /thugs rje'i lcags kyus 'dzin dgos zer/ /— 11 —

byis nga mad cha/bye'u chung mchil ba'i sde tshogs kyis/ /kyur kyur snyan glu len zhor du/ /'dab chags dad ldan nged cag la/ /chos 'khor thengs gcig skor dgos zer/ /ri thang mtshams kyi tsi gu tshos/ /rnam dag dad sems lhur blangs te/ /nyam thag 'gro ba 'dren pa'i mgon/ /gnas 'dir gtan du bzhugs dgos zer/ /spang gi rte'u lo dmar yag gis/ /sku bdag dbon po nga yin pas/ /dkar bo dge ba'i 'bul ba rnams/ /sri tshags bdag gnyer khos byed zer/ /

byis nga mad cha/byi tshogs nyung du bstungs na yang / /dam nyams dgra bo sgrol mkhas pa'i/ /khrag 'thung khro bo'i rgyal bo zhes/ /bstod pa ngag gi rnga gsang ldir/ /ril ma spu can btang na yang / /so skye phal bas dpog dka' ba'i/ /skyabs gnas grub pa'i dbang phyug ces/ /dad pa lus kyi ljon bzang 'gyel/ /

phaskul gyiphamisasan7pha yul gyi‘‘mi ma yin’’ka ba bzhin du drang ba'i yang dag gi bden don/ /kha shas shig gis ya yo 'khya 'khyog tu btang nas/ /ga shed gzhi rim zhig na dregs nyams kyis 'gying ba/ /nga yis de ring kun gyi snyan lam du zhu 'o/ /ca lag gang mang khug pa'i 'bul ba re blangs nas/ /cha med phyug po rgyus yod grogs po ru brtsis te/ /ja kha chang kha nyul nas lkog za la rngam pa'i/ /nya ge nyog ge bun bdag phag mgo de gcig red/ /tā rin dpon po'i mdun nas khyi bzhin du 'dur zhing / /tha mal dmangs kyi gseng nas stag ltar du mchongs te/ /da lta'i las byed bzang bo'i zhabs 'dren du gyur pa'i/ /— ༵ 1 nog ge yul gtso pho rlugs de gnyis red/ /

pa sangs mdangs la 'khu ba'i mdzad rjes shig med par/ /pha ma'i go sar 'thams nas dpon sa ru 'gos te/ /ba so lta bu'i slob gso'i rin thang ni bslad pa'i/ /ma rung khog bcug slob gtso klad dmar de gsum red/ /tsa ka 'bri bzhengs byed pa'i lag rtsal yang ma sbyangs/ /tshwa mtsho'i mdzes sdug mtshon pa'i snyan ngag kyang ma bris/ /dza ya'i gzhung la thos bsam nyams len yang med pa'i/ /wa mo tshos brgyan sku lo dkor gzan de bzhi red/ /zhwa gos mtshar bo gon na khram pa ru rtsi zhing / /za zed skra lo ring na jag pa ru rlom la/ /'a 'ur rtsed mor dga' na ngan pa ru bgrang ba'i/ /ya ma brla yi sde dpon tsho stig de lnga red/ /— 15 —

phalhul gyi4mis mi mir lug 'tsho skyong byed pa'i pha ma yi drin gyis/ /la lung yul gru nyul nas yi ge 'ga' bslabs te/ /sha khog tshon po brdzangs nas las gnas re rag na/ /sa mtho'i gnyen nyer sdang ba'i 'chal mo de drug red/ /trebitsho ha las ya mtshar ltad mor rdzogs mtha' ni med kyang / /rte a cang 'bri rgyu mang cha rlung rta la gnod 'gro /ṭ+wāṃ/ ha ne+e hon ne+e lag do go chod cig byas na/ / rīrdo/ a khu dpon po tsho yi thugs 'dun dang mthun no/ /

ri bong cal 'dro sar+ghaṃ bu da/ri bong cal 'drogs kyi bu rgyud/ristod kan nas phyogs chen 'brug bzhin ldir/ /me dmar bo'i zi ra glog ltar 'tshub/ /sa dog mo'i dkyil 'khor shig ger 'dar/ /g.yul 'thab 'dzing ki sgras yongs su khengs/ /wa rnga ma shad ler thang nas rgyug/shwa dung rwa krab be+er rdza nas zhogs/ /stag 'dzum drug nyil ler nags nas mchong / /seng g.yu ral ldem mer gangs nas gshar/ /shing bil ba'i skyed tshal nyams re dga'/ /sos dal ba'i ri bong bag re phab/ /

ri dzongajal 'dro sarkya bu /sems spro bas brtas te glu zhig blangs/ /yid dga' bas bzi nas bro re 'khrab/ /las gdug tsub mi yi nang dme 'dis/ /srog dmar chung 'phrog par gzab dgos zhes/ /phyi gra kha 'phyor ba'i wa mo des/ /zhe dkar bos ki gsum btab na yang / /sngon yang mes glen pa de dag gis/ /gtam ngan pa bod rmi bzhag yod pas/ /sman g.yo can zhig gi khram gtam la/ /nyan mi srid zer nas khrel dgod byed/ /mtshon mda' mo kha med mig med kyis/ /mgo klad zho gtor bar 'dzem dgos zhes/ /— ༵sngi ldem myur skyen pa'i sprel rgan des/ /

ri bong cal 'dro sashā bu da/yid drang bos tshig gsum gleng na yang / /shing bil ba chu ru lhung ba'i sgrar/ /sems 'jigs skrag skye don cang med pas/ /dman sdar ma zhig gi nyog gtam la/ /blo mi gtad ces te mgo bo g.yug/jigatam kha lce bde ba'i skya ril gyis/ /dpon nus med seng ge bros shul nas/ /spyir gcan gzan ri dwags thams cad kyi/ /thob tham ga'i bdag po kho byed zer/ /sems dran 'phrul rgod pa'i sngo ril gyis/ /blon rtsal med stag rgan song rjes su/ /mtho rgyal bo nyid kyi sku don du/ /blo rig pa'i zhabs tog khos sgrub zer/ /

ri pong cal 'drosat+pa sge danags sil tog zhim zas sngon du bshams/ /'jam lo ma'i brtsegs ma gdan du btings/ /yid dregs pas snyems pa'i ri bong tshos/ /gtam sna tshogs gleng mol ci yang bgyid/ /sh+ka1—— mgor rnam bcu dbang ldan btags pa des/ /mtho nyi zla sa ru brdabs na yang / /srog skyob pa'i mtshon srung 'di yod ces/ /mgo rna 'byog ring bo ltag par bsgrengs/ /lag shel dkar phreng chung bzung ba des/ /yul chos skyong srung ma'i dpung mthug pas/ /mgon kha 'dzin sdongs grogs myur ro zhes/ /—ṭ+wāṃtshar mig rdog 'jur bo ce rer bgrad/ /

ri bong cal 'dro sa② bu da/'bangs be+e sang kha chung dbang chung tshos/ /gnyan sngags 'chang chen mo'i bka' gsung ltar/ /las sku rim cho ga bsgrubs yod pas/ /bgegs bar chad mi 'byung gdeng yod zer/ /pha lha nas mched pa'i gtam zhig bshad/ /ma klu nas 'khrungs pa'i tshig cig glengs/ /rigs gdung rgyud rgod ces dpa' zhig 'phel/ /snag cho 'bring btsun zhes zhogs shig langs/ //jishing ljon pa'i gseng nas du smug 'thib/ /sha me yis 'tshig pa'i gsur dri thul/ /bya gong mos gshog 'gyur byed kyin du/ /grogs ri bong zer nas smre sngags 'don/ /— 21 —

bden pa bdar ba'i mchid/ḍatshedi khro gro —ṭ+wāṃ'adrerkang to dul sa dran du/nga ma zhang r+sha pa ma ngas zlong ra mnan//༵/ ṭ+wāṃ spra tsa/ zloṭ+wāṃ ༵ṭ+wāṃsdo tram̐~X ṭ+wāṃzlo sdus/ ba/rlags//drophags par chag spum shor ba'i gtam ngan mang //ṭ+wāṃngadagolhachoṭ+wāṃ t+tagārdo snasdu ༵dī snakāṭ+wāṃkā ṭīb dang //gas bad gle samuke 'u tsha gozlo//dīlhangakā ṭ+wāṃrdo gukāg ṭīkā gyad bye bag ru// nga ༄//gis tram̐~Xtwe3 sngak+shispyo/ nganārikha dzib/rīmosna blo/ pyarīchi kānywatshohabyespyo treju/zochos dad canazhig

ba pa bdar ba'isachid/phyogs zhen sgrib shing 'khor los yas g.yokas shing / /chags sdang gti mug stug pos mas btums te/ /rnam dag gzi dpal 'od kyis spud pa'i sku/ /lhang nger mthong bas bskal 'di yi re mug/'di snang mi rtag zlo ba'i char byo zhing / /stong snang 'khor bar 'chus pa'i chus sbangs kyang / /'tsho tshis don gnyer me stag phra mo'i rgyun/ /mi gshis gsom dkar phon pos che ru bskyed/ /lha yis ma bslad klu yis ma sbags shing / /gnyan gyis ma mnol btsan gyis ma chums pa/ /a 'thas ther zug 'jigs bral lta ba'i gdeng / /sa mtho'i dmu gab sel ba'i gsos su smin/ /

bde pa bdar ba'isgochi /'khyag grang bu yug 'tshub pa'i do ra na/ /rmongs zhen mkhregs 'dzin gor ma bongs po che/ /rtogs sad zha lu 'bus pa'i gar gcig gis/ /gas hrag hrug ger dus kyi glud du gtor/ / myeces brag ca'i chom sgrar 'drogs pa'i 'dab ldan khyus/ /——— skyabs 'tshol gcam bu'i gcong skad sgrog pa'i tshe/ /rang tshugs spobs pa'i gshog khyim cher brgyangs mkhan/ /mkha' lding khyed kyi stang stabs mig gi dpyid/ /'on te mnog chung bgyi bar sems phyogs shing / /'khos zhan khol bo'i tshogs dang ru bsdebs te/ /shing mchog sreg zar bstims pa'i col chung tshos/ /bsil ba'i khams na tho co ci yang byed/ /

bden pa bdar ba'isachid/'dre zhes dmod ngan skyogs sgras gnam sa bkang / /gdon zhes rgol ngan 'thab rnga phyogs bzhir brdungs/ /mi chos gtsor 'dzin rig pa'i ru 'dren pa/ /sha par dmigs pa'i g.yul 'gyed dgod re bro/ /sad pa grogs med hreng hreng dkar chung lug/ngan pa dgu 'dzoms kla klo'i spyang tshogs kyis/ /khyur mid btang yang gnas lugs khrag gi bcud/ /nges shes thi'u chung sbrum pa'i son du thor/ /bsam gzhig tsha grang 'thab pa sprin gyi sgra/rmongs pa thal bar bsregs pa gzhi sngon skyes/ /mun pa kun 'thibs smag gi lha lam nas/ /thol gyis ngom mdzad khyed 'dra srid na dkon/ /

tek+ta dus su babs pa'i bgro gleng /—— da mthun pa spun bzhi'i gtamazud dang sbyar nas zis/kyi hud stobs ldan khyu mchog ni/ /g.yo sgyu'i tshig gis brid byas te/ /gnyer ma'i gdong sogs tha shal tsho'i/ /khol bor gyur pa'i gtam de mtshar/ /srid na dkon pa ba so'i mche/ /'phar 'gro'i rtug pas sbags byas shing / /gyad stobs rdzogs pa bongs chen lus/ /gshog bkra'i brun gyis mnol de nongs/ /— 26 —

sa su babs pa'ibagro spengakasna zhags ring mo'i rngam zil gyis/ /'phrog byed snying rtsa 'dar byed na/ /nyam chung sdar ma de dag gis/ /gnya' bar dbang sgyur byed 'os ci/ /'jigs rung g.yul gyi do ra ru/ /ral gri'i 'khor lo bskor nas su/ /rkang gnyis tshogs kyang zhum byed pa'i/ /zla med dpa' gdeng gang du stor/ /bas mtha' ku sha'i thang chen du/ /gangs ri nur ba'i bgrod stangs kyis/ /snyan ngag mkhan yang dman sa ru/ /'god pa'i zil nyams ga ru song / /sgro khyod kyi rtsal la do zla ba'i/ /nus med khengs ldan wa skyes ni/ /0 tshangs dbyangasargya mcho'i rnamathar las jing

sa subabs pa'i bgro gleng /rnyi ba gcig gis gcir ba yi/ /ngag rgyun snyan mo nam dus bsnyel/ /rmad byung sa yi dbang phyug gi /srid kyi bgyi bar nyer mkho ba'i/ /rin chen bdun du bsngags pa yi/ /thob thang 'ja' sa su yis phrogs/ /dran 'phrul rno ba'i g.yo can tsho'i/ /skyes lo snga phyi'i slu tshig la/ /bden rdzun brdar sha mi gcod par/ /zhabs tog skub pa 'os sam ci/ /gzhan gyis zos pa'i lhag 'phro yi/ /shing tog rul bas yid tshims na/ /sngon byon mes po'i snyan grags ni/ /thal bar bsres pa ma yin nam/ /d+ngha 28 —

sa su babs pa'i bgro gleng /do med rtsal gyi bdag nyid can/ /skyes stobs dpal gyis snyems pa khyod/ /bran du bkol ba'i ngang tshul de/ / tenakha ba'i ljongs su ha cang brin/ /mthun pa spun bzhi'i gtam rgyud ltar/ /srol ngan gog po'i mnga' khongs su/ /gson shugs rgyas pa'i lta ba ni/ /nam yang 'khums nas 'dug dgos zer/ /sprel dang ri bong sreg pa bzhin/ /bla rdol 'byin pa'i 'thom rkyal tshor/ /bla med cho lo bstsal nas su/ /spyi bo'i gtsug tu bkur dgos smra/ /mchog gyur dbu yi nor bu yang / /khram pa'i rkang bar gtugs pa yi/ /'khos zhan g.yog po'i 'tsho stangs ni/ /dge mtshan bye bas spud do skad/ /

sa su babs pa'i bgro glenganagacig nyid gcig gi gnya' ba ru/ /'gying ba'i rjes su yi rang nas/ /mi drag glen pa'i rkang stegs su/ /mi lus byas pa 'os so lo/ /rgas gnyer chags pa'i ngo gdong ni/ /'jon thang dpang bor rlom nas su/ /kha dbang btsan po'i bka' lung gis/ /bkod 'doms byas ma rung ngo grag/dar srol ngan pa'i khres po'i rdzid/ /phrag tu 'degs pa'i lag do tshor/ /tshul ldan skyes bu bzang bo zhes/ /bstod pa don dang mthun no skad/ /bran gshis 'thibs po'i khyod tsho'i ris/ /mchod khri'i steng du bshams pa 'gas/ /rdzob ngan khol bo'i stangs ka der/ /— 30 sdo bde'i mtshan snyan 'dogs par rngam/ /

sa su babs pa'i bgro gleng/kye ho thal kar gzhon nu khyod/ /had nas sdod pa 'os min pas/ /sa chen 'khyom 'dra'i gyad shugs kyis/ / 7zheragom stabs brtan po spo re ran/ /mu to'i rtul zhugs dor nas ni/ /zhim mngar sil tog gsar ba'i bcud/ /ci 'dod longs su spyod pa yi/ /rdzogs ldan gsar ba bsus na 'tshams/ /dus mtha'i rlung dmar 'tshubs 'dra yi/ /shugs ldan sprug brdabs gcig nyid kyis/ /nga 'o snyam pa'i col chung tsho/ /glud gtor bzhin du da re g.yugs/ /kāsngi ༵/ snasnakyā ༵ ṭ+wāṃme+e ༵nga/sa/ po/ /rang dbang dpal la rol ba yi/ /khri gnyan tshogs kyis brgyan na mdzes/ /

las byed pa mgon med skyabs med 'ga'/gzhan dbang lhags 'tshub kyis spur ba'i rlung rta ji bzhin/ /ri sul lung kyog gi khugs su lhab lhub 'phyo dus/ /kha char bu yug gi gdug tsub ngar sha che bas/ /phugs 'dun tshon rtsi yi mdog kyang skya bor bsgyur song / /'ur mthil gor mo ru bde ba'i rdo ba ltar du/ /klad du thengs dgu ru bskor nas rgyang la 'phangs tshe/ /sdug yus 'khang ra yi skyo gtarma shub bur zlo bzhin/ /nem ljang spang thang gi dbus su khyim gzhi spar yod/ /smra shes don go yi the ge zad por brtsis nas/ /mi drag sku drag tshos gang sar 'ded grangs mang bas/ /'khyer bde 'gyog bde yi mal khri nyis bltabs byas te/ /rna ḍi swā~X dze+eng du bka' gsung gnyan por gtad yod/ /

lasargyad pas lged skyabasar+ghada' 'a/gar btang go chod kyi nyam thag lag dor bgrangs nas/ /rgyu med rkyen med du rgyang phud rgyag thengs mod pas/ /nyi glog gong bde re gar yo da rtsad gcod byas te/ /dben gnas 'gol bo zhig 'grim par sngon 'gro skrun dgos/ /sras dang sras mo yi bde skyid rtag tu brtan phyir/ /las byed phogs gzan tsho'i mtha' srung dmag mir gyur te/ /gzhan pas khrel 'dzum gyis 'phya ba'i las gnas steng du/ /mi lo du ma zhig dka' sdug chen pos zad song / /sku ngo'i khyim rgyud kyi 'gal rkyen bar chad sel phyir/ /dus rabs nyer gcig pa'i gtor ma gsar bar gyur te/ /rang dbang spu rtse tsam med par phyogs bzhir gtor dus/ /skyo gdung 'khyag po zhig sems kyi zab sar sbas yod/ /gser rtsi ser bo yis byugs pa'i shog bya ji bzhin/ /a pha'i thob thang gi skud pa'i sne mor 'thams nas/ /nyi ma'i drod khol gyi brtse ba btsan gyis bsnyegs te/ /yam yom 'khyar 'khyor du 'phur ba gan tshor bshibs na/sdi/33 —

las byed pazab dze+e bsadze+ed 'a 'a/rngam brjid ri tshogs kyi rtse mo zil gyis mnan te/ /yid 'ong dregs nyams kyis 'gying ba'i dar lcog ltar du/ /'brog sde'i slob chung du sgyugs pa'i pho rgod nged tsho'i/ /dbu 'phang sbrin gseng du slebs pa'i nyams snang skyes byung / /dpon ngan rdzob po tsho'i rkang mthil lce yis ldag ste/ /zas lhag snum po re slong ba'i o yo ltar du/ /mnog chung khe phan gyi ched du lang tsho bstems pa'i/ /bran khol g.yog gshis kyis sbags pa de tshor bsdur na/ /ngar rgod gad rgyangs kyis sa chen shig ger sgul ba'i/ /g.yu ral phrag steng du snyil ba'i gangs seng ji bzhin/ /rang gshis gsha' ma re srung ba'i skyes mchog bdag cag/snying stobs dgu 'gyur gyis spud pa'i spobs pas khengs song / /mi min skor tshogs shig go sa'i them par 'dzegs shing / /lto 'phye chen po 'gas skyid pa'i tshang mal rnyed skabs/ /tsher ma tshang tshing du skyes pa'i 'gag 'phrang mang bos/ /mi n+d+ra swā~X n+d+rag tsho'i bzhud lam btsan gyis bcad yod/ /

las byed pas med skyabs med 'a 'a/ya them sra mo de'i 'og nas khyi ltar sgur zhing / /ma them bkan mo de'i steng nas wa bzhin 'jabs na/ /col chung skye bo tsho 'tshang sa'i skyibs shig yo da kyang / /mgo bo mthon po 'di dud pa'i thabs shig mi 'dug/dkar nag go ldog gis drang bden rdog pas brdzis nas/ /sku ngo'i 'dzum mdangs la dungs pa'i rkub g.yog dag gis/ /nged tsho'i zhabs sor gyi zhol nas rgyang mthong btsugs te/ /gnas ri brjid po zhig 'dug ces mgo yom 'khor srid/ /

par len sgyu rtsal dang gzhan dga'aja' sna lnga 'od lam mer dbu rgyan gyi gur khang / /sprin tshom bu dkar gsal ler sku lus kyi na bza'/ /mdzes me tog khra spung nger bzhugs khri ru 'god pa'i/ /bzo rig pa'i 'phrul rtsa9 de blo yul las 'gongs pa/ /sems ya chung dungs lhang nger dad sems kyis brtas te/ /ngag phra mo brel 'tshab be+er gsol 'debs la zhen nas/ /lus gus phyag kum tsog ger shog drul der 'tshal ba'i /nang phu nu'i rtul zhugs de smra brjod las 'das pa/ /zhal pad mo 'dzum lhug ger spro snang gis spud de/ /phyag dron mos 'jam shig ger byugs byugs re gnang gin/ /sman sgeg mor spyan ce rer ting 'dzin ni sgom pa'i/ /rje bla ma'i mdzad pa de rang gshis kyis phongs pa/ /— 36 —

par le ba la dang na dgayu byu ru ljid tig ger mgrin rgyan du dpyangs nas/ /'gros gom pa dal ldem mer ngang chung bzhin bsgyur te/ /lag thal mo mnyen lhag ger dpral ba ru sbyor ba'i/ /khyim rig ma'i bkur ste de zhe 'dang las brgal ba/ / ————/drin pha los khro gtum mer bka' bkyon gyis bcums shing / /byams ma los gnyom dung nger gtam snyan gyis bslus nas / /bu lhag ma skyo hreng nger tshogs gral du 'ded pa'i / / chos dge ba'i sgrub phyogs de rang dbang dang gyes pa/ /rgyab gon pa snum kyug ger lhan pa yis khebs shing / /gzhi khang khyim brlan tsar rer thigs pa yis sbangs kyang / /dngul sgor mo dga' krog ger dgon pa ru 'bul ba'i/ /rgyu zang zing gtong phod de bsags nor las che ba/ /sems btang snyoms kha mur rer nam rgyun du zlo zhing / /byams bzod pa bden cog ger dus rtag tu gleng yang / /rtsom gsar bar mun 'thom mer ngan smras ni byed pa'i/ /ban ser mo'i bya spyod de kha bshad dang 'gal ba/ / — 37 —

nga zan zusgo zla shā tsho rtsadarta 'do ba 'tsher si lir bsngos rta ru phul zhing / /'bri mdzo mo rwa ldem mer 'o rgyun du bzhag nas/ /bu dwa phrug skya ril ler mug skyob la brten pa'i/ /gshin dge rtsa'i rdzongs pa 'ga' pha nor dang mnyam pa/ /mkhar khang ba 'khyag sib be+er srib phyogs nas brtsigs shing / / sgra mthing skug grang bsil ler rlung kha nas phub ste/ /—— skyid nyi 'od dro lam mer dgra phyogs su 'ded pa'i/ /rtsis kun shes lung bstan de gangs skyon las thu ba/ /ngo ya thod gnyer nye rer rga ba yis bcom zhing / /lus lhu drug gyong rid ler na ba yis gzir te/ /dgra 'chi bdag nag rog ger sgo 'gram du lhags pa'i/ /gnyan sngags 'chang byin mthu de rang srung du zhan pa/ /— 38 —
sred/nga yi yid 'phrog snying sdug tsam pa ka /ga zha dgod sgra snyan pa'i dmar chung kha/ /kha sgo dung so mjos pa'i 'o de ga/ka ra bzhin du myang na 'dod mkhan nga / /

pho khyo gaskyes pho rgod ngas gus phyag nam yang mi sgur/ /ri lhun po yi zhol nas phyag cig 'tshal na/ /sa dog mo 'di rnam pa drug du g.yos te/ /'brong ru dmar ni rbab tu 'gril yang srid do/ /skyes pho rgod ngas gus phyag nam yang mi sgur/ /gtsang chu chen gyi 'gram nas phyag cig 'tshal na/ /rdo gram pa yi kha zheng lhang la bud de/ /nya gser mig gis 'chi 'phag bya 'ang srid do/ /skyes pho rgod ngas gus phyag nam yang mi sgur/ /nags rgya rdzong gi dkyil nas phyag cig 'tshal na/ /rtsal 'gran med kyi dus mtha'i rlung dmar 'tshubs te/ /gzhi brtan brling gi sdong rgan bsnyel yang srid do/ /— 40 —

po skyes pho rgod ngas gus phyag nam yang mi sgur/ /ljang ne'u gsing gi ngogs nas phyag cig 'tshal na/ /dpal gzi 'od kyi zi ra chem mer mched de/ /mdzes me tog gi 'dab ma bsreg kyang srid do/ /ngas gus phyag cig gser mdog nyi mar gnang na/ /dgung nyi gzhon ni bred sha ches cher langs te/ /sprin dkar nag gi yol ba myur du 'then nas/ /lho 'dzam gling 'di mun pas bsgribs na ci bya/ /ngas gus phyag cig dung mdog zla bar bstsal na/ /mtshar zla gsar yang mgo yo ma rab tu 'khor nas/ /mtho sprin lam gyi dbyings su gom kha 'chol te/ /dgung skar chen tshor gdong thug brgyab na ci bya/ /ngas gus phyag cig steng ma lha la gnang na/ /gong lha dbang gi kha rje rlung rta rgud cing / /'khor lha 'bangs kyi tshe bsod dbang thang nyams te/ /sgeg lha sman tsho yugs sar bud na ci bya/ / — 41 —

za ngas gus phyag cig 'og ma klu la bstsal na/ /nya sbal lcong gi cho nge phyogs bzhir khyab cing / /klu nor rgyas kyi dran pa thengs dgur thor nas/ /mchog rin bral gyi nor bu stor na ci bya/ /sngon mdun phyogs nas gser gyi mkhar zhig brdungs shing / /gzhug rgyab phyogs su gzi yi ri zhig spungs te/ /phyag thengs gcig tu 'tshal ba'i skyes su byin yang / /mtho dbu 'phang gi ched du sa rdor brtsis chog/gzhogs g.yas pa nas gshed mas ral gri brdar zhing / /'gram g.yon rol nas bshan pas dgra sta phyar te/ /dman bran khol gyi stangs kas sgur dgos she na/ /dpa' gad rgyangs kyi nga ros zil gyis mnan chog/btsan dpon ngan tsho'i dbang gis gong nas bcun zhing / /rdzun bla sprul tsho'i stobs kyis phrag nas bcums kyang / /dbu spyi gtsug ni a sngon dbyings su gtad pa/ /tram̐sdu2 dun+d+ra 'gro dang bdag tha/ dbye mtshams yin no/ /

kha ba'i me togazhe 'dang dar skud nyid la 'then nas bgrang bya'i nyag ma bcu lhag 'gor/ /rkyen dbang btsan po bka' lung dog pas re ba'i 'ja' tshon dgung du yal/ /yid 'ong ma khyod rgyang nas g.yol ba'i smra ba nyung ba'i smyug 'dzin pas/ /dungs zhen me dpung sems su sbar ba lus phra sgeg mos ga la rtogs/ /tho rengs skar chen gsal ler 'tsher 'dra'i 'jo sgeg 'bum ldan spyan mig ni/ /yid sems 'gugs pa'i lcags kyur mtshungs pas pho gzhon brang khong 'jags thabs bral/ /mu tig do shal thol gyis 'thor lta'i rnam dag dwangs gtsang pha skad mchog/tam bu ra yi dbyangs bzhin snyan pas stag shan+d+ra 43 —

ba'i metoblo kha bde bar dka'/ /nābyi /༵ phroṃ zlosnan nyi/nga/ khus bzhengs pa we na si yi pir thogs bye bas bstod tshogs ldir ba mo na li sa'i mnyes gshin 'dzum/ /gangs ri'i ljongs kyi dwangs ma'i sman shar seng lcam 'brug mo'i drang ldem sku/ /'jig rten byed pos gcig tu bsdus te khyod kyi snang brnyan lhang nger bslun/ /gzur gnas dam pas yang yang brtags na nyes pa'i rdul snyigs yod kyang srid/ /tāṭītā /nā ljo byizlo/ zhi/ba tu gzhal na skyon gyi cha 'on te bdag gi dmar chung sems par 'dod lhas mda' mo bsnun drags pas/ /gang nyid dpal gyi lhun por brtsi ba'i chags — 44 tram̐n rtsal 'di zlog par dka'/ /

ba'i me tormi lam klong du brang skyes 'o 'dzin gangs de'u las kyang gtsang na yang / /'dab ldan khyim byas dus brda gtong dus hreng hreng gcig pur skyengs pas gzir/ /'char yan gseng na drod khol mchu sgros pad 'dab ji bzhin 'jam na yang / /dngos yod 'tsho bar dmigs pa gtod skabs skyo ba'i 'khun chung dbang med shor/ /grong 'jug man ngag tshad mar grub na phye leb gshog pas lus spud de/ /'phur lding gar gyi stangs stabs rtsen gyin snying gtam shub bur gleng na bsam/ /sgyu ma'i sprul sgyur bden du snang na mdza' brtse ut+pal sngon po'i phreng / /lo zla 'khor mo'i mu khyud ring mor mgrin pa'i rgyan du bstar na 'dod/ /

ba'idze+ebaslu brid 'thibs pa'i rgyab gzugs phra mo khrom chen gseng nas mngon thengs rer/ /zhi dul sgam brling btsan gyis bsgoms kyang zur mig 'gog med phyogs der shor/ /smag rum khu bas lan brgyar byugs 'dra'i skra lo'i rbab chu nag po yis/ /tshor 'du'i na'u gsing bcud kyis brlan te snyan ngag gang bu rnam par smin/ /thog ma'i mdza' 'phrin khyod la bris shing zhib tshags nan mos klog gin du/ /thun sum mtshan mo gnyid dang bral ba'i bsam gzhig ring mo thengs gcig min/ /smra shāsnaṭī ṭ+wāṃ sna py-i/ ༵5 / bu/ra bkram ste mtshar sdug bdag 'dzin tha gus dam du 'ching ba'i lkog gyur jus gzhi lan mang bshams/ /— 46 sri lta lags mod blo dman bdag nyid snying

ba'idze+estostobs go chas phongs pa yis/ /phar rgol 'phrin las yongs su dor te rang sems sdug la sbyor ba las/ /ṭīwa sbya~X kā sna ṭā/nga /dngos su phrad nas kho bo khyod gsang ba'i ri mo rjen par ston pa'i rtul phod dpa' gdeng kun nas zhum/ /'du long 'khrigs pa'i mi tshogs dbus dang 'a 'ur che ba'i tshong ra ru/ /mnyen lhug skye lus rgyang nas 'tshos te lam 'gro'i rtul zhugs skyong don yang / /lhad med dngul gyi mdangs la 'khu ba ma bcos mdzes pa'i dpal 'dzoms pa'i/ /brtse dung kha ba'i me tog dkar bo khyod la phul tshe zhu bar dogs/ /— 7 —

'brog dgon gyi slob chung // zlor+sha ngarba/ rla/bas kyi rtse ru g.yang dkar lbu phreng me ṭ+wāṃg t+takar da ma ra gyi ngogs su bung bas snyan / bye ṭ+wāṃ rte /yu/la ljongs kyi bkod pa ri mo ltar du mdzes pa'i/ /rnyisdoṭ+wāṃ sdo ༵/gol/ bo ru gnas pa'i slob chung 'di kā shāsna snaspyag/ sha/ mo yi 'tsho bcud lus kyi gsos tweng mdog ri sgog gi bro bas 'gram chu dbang ༵sdo sbyir+sha ༵ /ba/go skal gyi dngos grub rgyal bo'i mdzod bzhin 'ardzoms pa'i/ / — 48 zibrog sa 'gol bo ru gnas pa'i slob chung 'di

'ablo da gyi slobachungakanyid skyid pa/ /trī sdospratrī ṭ+wāṃ tram̐stod kyi zol bcos sems kyi ga'i stanasdo matre ṭ+wāṃ be ṭ+wāṃ /khyad/ gsod kyi lta stangs blo yi ————///mi95 cad tshod14cad nga// / spro chadabye n+dha zlo natshu ༵'i lda/ na/ gyi rdzi bu'i rang ga sa ga skar rnyisdoṭ+wāṃ sdo ༵/gol/ bo ru gnas pa'i slob chung 'di / ༵/sna ngasgo/ma/ chen ltar dul ba'i 'phyi ba rtswa la /zlosna ṭ+wāṃ kā ༵pro sache t+na/ da/nga mnyam pa'i rgod pos ṭīd+ngha ༵dro~X ༵ ṭā/ra/ yug gi rnam pas skyo ba rang 'brog sa 'gol bo ru gnas pa'i slob chung 'di nyid skyid pa/ / — 49 —

shā 11 'di 3) :sgong sgrona'aju /dwangs gtsang mkha' dbugs kyi mthun rkyen bdud rtsi sman las mchog cing / /khams bde sems skyid kyi ne+e'u gsing skyed mos tshal bzhin mtshar ba/ /ṭ+wāṃspra /rtse/na lha yul gyi dum bu dog mo sa ru lhung rnyisdoṭ+wāṃ sdo ༵/gol/ bo ru gnas pa'i slob chung 'di hār+sha // / t+na bye/ra /gyi gseng na gangs ri'i cod gyu /skar/ do shal gyi 'og tu spang ljongs dri zhim thul dpal ldan yum chen gyi 'jig rten sgeg nyams bye bas spud pa'i/ /rnyi/ṭ+wāṃ sdo py-i/gol/ bo ru gnas pa'i slob chung 'di —— 50 —

'i 21 'di 3) smi1ba chunganaspratā sna ༵sna ༵/ lcu/gas su 'dar ba'i be'u chung khra shāsdu sdo/ lda /'a/khyar 'khyor du spo ba'i bu chung tshe ge'adepa/ nā sdo ṭ+wāṃ~X py-ispra/ra /ba yi gang bu gegs med rnyisdoṭ+wāṃ sdo ༵/gol/ bo ru gnas pa'i slob chung 'di trī shākā k+ṣiṃspya zloshāsdu /po /yi bzhad sgra phugs 'dun shāsdu ༵ṭā ༵drorno sna/ yi/ 'dzum chung dungs sems py-i ༵dī rnyispyakā ltaspra /ga/zhis ni dron po dga' snang rnyisdoṭ+wāṃ sdo ༵/gol/ bo ru gnas pa'i slob chung 'di dgong kha'i nyi zer gyi klong du 'bri mos skyug ldad 51 —

'ablo da gyi slob chung/byed skabs/ /mtshams sprin ser po der bltas te 'brog mos 'jo glu len pa'i/ /phul byung mdzes sdug gi stangs stabs sku gus mtshon thabs bral ba/ /'brog sa 'gol bo ru gnas pa'i slob chung 'di nyid skyid pa/ /skya rtsal ge sar bzhin skyen pa'i pho rgod glog ltar 'gyu zhing / /sgeg nyams 'brug mo las mtshar ba'i mo gzhon bal las 'jam pa/ /khra mo gling sde yi bu rgyud nyams med 'tsho gzhes gnang sa'i/ /'brog sa 'gol bo ru gnas pa'i slob chung 'di nyid skyid pa/ / — pya2 —

'dzo da na gyi slob chungadigaces pa'i sras chung dang mtshungs par slob bur brtsi bkur ldan 'ing / /byams pa'i yab yum dang 'dra bar bshes gnyen brtse bas phyug pa/ /mthun sgril rogs res kyi srol bzang ma nyams yun du skyong ba'i/ /'brog sa 'gol bo ru gnas pa'i slob chung 'di nyid skyid pa/ /'char yan snyan 'jebs kyi ri glu lhun po'i spo na 'phyur zhing / /rtog btags yid 'phrog gi ngag rgyun mthing smug spra las mched de/ /spro skyid dgod sgra yi tshom bus 'tsho bar mdzes rgyan spras pa'i/ /'brog sa 'gol bo ru gnas pa'i slob chung 'di nyid skyid pa/ / — 53 —

'ablo da gyi slob chung /dbyar gsum 'ja' tshon gyi khugs pa za 'og gos ltar bkra zhing / /dgun gsum rab dkar gyi kha ba dngul gyi bye'u bzhin 'phyo ba/ /'dzam gling mtho sgang gi dbu ru mtshar sdug tog tu 'greng ba'i/ /'brog sa 'gol bo ru gnas pa'i slob chung 'di nyid skyid pa/ /ston gsum smug long gi dbus su 'o ma'i bsung zhim thul zhing / /dpyid gsum bsil rlung gi dkyil du sbrang rtsam ngad khas khyab ste/ /thun min 'tsho ba yi 'gyur khugs lhang nger gzengs su thon pa'i/ /'brog sa 'gol bo ru gnas pa'i slob chung 'di nyid skyid pa/ /— 5zhe —

'ad ba nga ci tshababyekrob 25/gad skyigs sgrug pa'i bgrosapo/ka li skra med sngags pa'i rnga ltar dmar/ /kha yi so thor skyi mo'i thum khug bzhin/ /ga nas bltas kyang yi dwags 'dre 'dra ba/ /nga 'dra'i lo lon thams cad snying re rje/ /ca lag cung tsam bsogs pa bu yis brlags / /cha yo da grogs 'ga' yod pas rgyang nas g.yol/ /ja 'phro zas 'phror rol te tshe mjug zad/ /nya khrab lta bu'i lhan pas lwa steng khebs/ /

rtsad ba nga /ri rnga ༷sprotha cas/tā re sgrol mar gsol ba btab na yang / /tha mal bdag 'drar dngos grub mi thob cing / /da skabs bu dang mna' mas mnar ba yis/ /na rgas rgan po skyo ba lhag par skyes/ /pa lags zer nas gong du bkur mi med/ /pha rgan zer nas zhabs tog sgrub mi med/ /ba glang lkog shal med pa'i bu phrug 'ga'/ /ma shi gson por gnas kyang don go chung / /tsa ra ra yi mig chu bzhur ba na/ /tshwa rdog spar gang mig nang btab pa 'dra/ /dza re dzo re'i gad snyigs 'thu ba'i tshe/ /wa skyes 'theng bos ri sul nyul dang mtshungs/ /

thad tha nga ya tshabaXsprothagaspus/zhwa gos lham gsu ma thed na 'tshem mkhan med/ /za 'thung 'tsho bas phongs na nyo mkhan med/ /'a 'ur 'du 'dzi'i ltad mor 'khrid mkhan med/ /ya nga'i 'chi nad byung yang ngu mkhan med/ /ra sa ming grags che yang nga mi thon/ /lā mo kun bdedunye yang ngas mi mthong / /sha mar thud gsum zhim yang ngar mi thems/ /sa steng 'di ru bsdad kyang snying bo ci/ /ha go don rtogs mi ru skyes na yang / /a cang gdung bas gzir 'di yi re mug/ha lam 'chi bdag bdud po slebs nye bas/ /a tsi 'chi khar mnar gcod med par shog/du dgonapa'ig

'utshang yutshu sa/'u tshang gi yu tshugs/srong btsan gtsug rdo rang byung dbu yod zer/ /'u dum mgo na ltas ngan rwa yo da zer/ /phyi mi 'khyar bo zhig gis mthong ba'i tshe/ /'jigs dngangs bred sha skyes pa gcig mtshungs red/ /nang na dmar nag ༵ yis 'tshig nye yang / /phyi ru rnga dang rol mo'i sgra dkrol te/ /lha bzo kun dgar skyel ma byed myong ba'i/ /mi rigs 'di yi go rtogs nam re sad/ /gnya' khri btsan po ༵ brang sprul bar gleng / /ru las skyes kyi rus khungs g.yag la gtugs/ /snga rabs mes po krog krog 'dre ru brtsis/ /nged tsho'i rnam dag lo rgyus gang nas klog/— 58 —

stod na chos skyong sruḍi ma sprin ltar 'thibs / /bar na dgra lha wer ma glog ba'in 'khyugs/ /rtsal med dpung sdongs byas nas rgyal ba'i tshe/ /gling dkar dpa' rtul zer nas mthe bong sgrong / /rta rgan gnam nas ༵phur na som nyi med/ /mda' mos mi skad bshad tshe the tshom dben/ /ma bzhi'i dpon po'i ma bcos mi yi gshis/ /ma rung mtshar du brtsi ba bod kyi dpe/ /nyi mar bltas na mi/ zung long bar dogs/ /skar ma brtsis na tshe tshad thung bar 'jigs/ /grib mar cer na gdon gyis gnon par bred/ /skrag ma dngangs su 'tsho ba rol 'di skyo/ / — pya9 —

'u tshang uchu sa/pur rgyal btsan po py-i tshe brtan pa'i phyir/ /gson por dur khung bsnyegs pa'i blon chen der/ /blo dkar gzhung drang cho lo mi stsol bar/ /bdud kyi ming ngan mi lo stong du btags / /dbyin ji'i deng rabashā mtshon cha'i gdong len du/ /'ur rdo chu mig dgu sgril 'phangs pa yis /mi 'jigs dpa' bo'i snying stobs mngon mod kyang / /rjes lus rmongs pa'i gnas bab lhag tu mtshon/ /pha nor dgos 'dod9 dpung 'joms dgra la byin/ /gces pa'i khyim mi nyam thag bran du brdzangs/ /gzhan gyi sdug bsngal dge ba'i rgyur bsngos pa'i/ /— 6༵sngi rgyun rdzob por bstod dbyangs ldir mkhan mang / /

'utshang u chu sa/gces srog gnong dṛzlo wa mor g.yo can zer/ /rkub g.yog rgyug pa'i dud 'gror g.yang zog brjod/ mnog chung khe phan phra mos tshad bcal te/ /lugs med 'chal gtam smra bar 'dzem bag med/ /dpe rgyan so gnyis dho rdog ma 'gyur 'ing / /gzugs rgyan nyi shu'i go rim ma 'khrugs par/ /‘‘dpe brjod’’'jog par dga' ba'i blo dman pa/ /gangs ljongs dus deb kun gyi gces phrug red/ /mi las 'jag ma'i py-i / sku bshams dus / /bod du skyes pas cung tsam gug 'dug zer/ /rgya gar a tsa ra yis bsgrigs pa'i tshe/ /'jag rtse mda' mo bzhin du 'drobs so lo/ / — 61

'utshang yu chu sa/seng lcam 'brug mo py-i ༵ga rgyal du bzhag/snang sa 'od 'bum zhe 'dang dbang gis phrogs/ /bsil mo ljongs kyi na chung sgeg mo tsho'i/ /mi tshe'i bshul lam ring mo mchi mas brlan/ /yang mes bzang bodṛ shā so'i thel yod cing / /a mes dpa' bor byu ru'i tog yod pas/ /deng skabs dbul skyor skyabs su bsten dgos kyang / /bu dang bu mo'i gnyen ya mtho dgos zer/ /mdzes ldan sgeg mo~X /zhug tu bu khrid cing / /pang du bu mo glan nas 'gro ba'i tshe/ /sked pa yo da med 'phyang mo nyug go zhes/ /— 6spyaka thogs pa 'ga'‘‘snyan ngag’’'bri bar brel/ /

'u tshang yu tshu sa/dgun gsu ma kha bzlo shādab ma dalar lha ba lha ba/ /ston gsum skyin thang bu yug 'khyag sib sib/ /pags slag mthug pos gcud pa'i rang rigs kyis/ /pad ma'i gnyen las bsil sbyin mkhan por bstod/ /gdug can srin mo ṭ+wāṃ~X la dgod pa'i phyir/ /khong gis de nyid khab tu bzhes so zhes/ /nag med nyes pa'i skyon cha chen po zhig/sgeg ldan rig ma'i mgo ru btsan gyis bkal/ /sprul sku chang gis baṭ+wāṃ ༵ nga mdzad spyod zer/ /grwa bas stegs sgang rtses na bstan bathig zer/ /yon bdag phyogs ris can tsho'i mig lam na/ /drang bden gnas lugs zer ba yod re skan/ / — 63 —

'u tshang u chu sa/khyim pa'i legs skyedṛ r+shadon gyi rdzas su dogs/ /dgon pa'i nas rdog 'tsho byed sman du rlom/ /nyi mar kha thag nye ba'i pha sa 'dir/ /rtogs sad 'od kyi nyag ma shin tu phra/ /g.yang mda' khra mo ṭ+wāṃr+sha' ru 'phyar gyin du/ /gzhan la phywa g.yang 'gugs pa'i a mchod der/ /mug skyob dbul skyor grogs su ma 'byor na/ /lo mjug 'khyol bar dka' ba yi re phya/ /pha rgan bgres pos ṭ+wāṃr+shas rjes ma chod par/ /ri gsum rtse nas mchi ma thengs gsum gtor/ /gces bus khyim nas kha ton zlo ba'in du/ /— 6༵sdi ba rigs drug ched du gsol ba 'debs/ /

'u tshang lha chu sa/lha khang bzhengs naṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃs ston byed skabs su/ /dad pa can gyi yon bdag brel 'tshab 'tshab/ /nyi ma longs nas slob ma 'tshogs dus na/ /u tshugs che ba'i khyim bdag dal lhod lhod/ /ban rgan zhig gis ṭ+wāṃ/ sku gcig bskyed na/ /yongs 'dzin dam pa'i mtshan gyis gong du bkur/ /khyim pa zhig gis shes ldan brgya bskyangs kyang / /dge rgan phal ba'i tshul gyis dman par bgrangs/ /mchan nas skyor baṭ+wāṃ ༵ lags bgres po der/ /stobs ldan gzhon nus skyabs 'jug zhus na yang/ /gnas der thol gyis sa yo ma brgyugs pa na/ /su zhig su la re ba sus kyang shes/ /

'u tshang yu chu sa/rang rigs spra dang ṭ+wāṃṭ+wāṃ las mched pa dag/rgyal bu gzhon nu'i btsun mor mi 'os zhes/ /gnyen ya ga'an gyi phyogs nas 'tshol ba yi/ /col chung yog li bod na shin tu mang / /yab chen sprel por zloṭīs sems che zhes bstad/ /yum mchog spra mor gtum spyod rgod ces smad/ /skyes ma dman par bgrangs pa'i srol ngan 'dis/ /lo rgyus chu klung ring mo mgo nas brnyogs/ /bstan la khag bzha/ r+shater la sems shor nas/ /gzhan sder bcom 'phrog g.yul 'gyed byas pa der/ /ge sar rgyal bos bdud cig btul lo zhes/ /— 6ni n+d+rabs bod pas yang dang yang du bsngags/ /

mdzes pa'i zhal raṭ+wāṃ ༵da mo'i ris kyis brgyan/ /rje btsun sgrol ma'i rnam sprul dngos yin 'es/ /rgya nag bu mo'i lo rgyus gleng ba'i tshe/ /bden min the tshom skye mkhan bod na nyung / /dgun zla bcu ba'i /py-i du 'brug cig grags/ /'brug skad snyan mor 'grogs te char zhig babs / /sbrang char zim bu'i gseng nas 'ja' zhig shar/ /'di ni bod kyi sprul sku'i‘‘'khrungs rabs’’yin/ /mkhas pa gcig gi~X r+shasungs pa'i legs bathad las/ /blun po khri yis smras pa'i nyog bshad ni/ /gnas lugs bden pa'i snying bor brtsi ba'i srol/ /bsam zhing bsam na yi mug sangs dus med/ / — 67 —

dbul bos yid ba/rdo nor bu rnyed rjes su/ /gsol ba btab nas phyug por gyur ba yi/ /rtsol chung le lor phyogs pa'i gtam rgyud dag/sgyid lug bsam blo'i khushā/ zho dron po yin/ /rang rigs 'brog /ṭ+wāṃ khyim nas nar son yang / /gzhan rigs slob grwa 'grim pa'i skabs byung na/ /bod pa'i skad kyis kan la ci zer zhes/ /lug gi ril ma ston pa'i mdo med mang / /nyag ga khis khar da/ /'i dar zhig 'dzugs/ /lhun po gtsang bor mchod pa'i bsang zhig rtsi/ /skye rga na 'chir las kyis 'grel re rgyag/— 6ḍirji byung khams na 'u cag nyam re chung / /

'utshang u chu sa/ge sar rgyal bos da/༵ khams cher dkrugs shing / /a stag klu mos gshin rje'i maso bskor ba'i/ /mi yu la dpa' bo'i snying stobs mi bstod par/ /las mkhan dred mgor zhed pa'i sdar ma mang / /
mastoriskalastojaka sabariskami yig rmongs kyis oṃ yig sgo khar sbya'adre yig rmongs shig tsham tshom med

sha mchin pa'i steng 'og brje gid dgon chung zhig dang de'i'adabs②slobachung /'du khang khra mo gzi byin lam lam/ /gser tog ser bo bkrag mdangs krig krig/btsun chung gzhon nu'i 'du 'god lang long / /dad ldan mjal ba'i gsol 'debs shab shub/ /slob grwa'i ra skor gyang hrul nyal nyil/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen grogs med rkyang rkyang / /mi kha gnyan po me stag mched mched/ /khyim bdag btsan po stag mo mchong mchong / / — 71 ——

mchi pa'i nga 'o brje zhal 'debs dkar thigs 'o ma 'phyur 'phyur/ /bsang dud sngon mo g.yu 'brug 'khyug 'khyug/tshe 'bar mar me skar ma 'char 'char /mjal dar kha btags gangs skya 'bab 'bab/ /gsar zhugs 'dzin grwa dmag khral bsdu bsdu/ /dpe rin sgor 'ga' bu lon 'ded 'ded/ /slob ma kha shas shor ma 'bro 'bro/ /pha mar thug na bag ma ngu ngu / /chos sgor zhugs na mthe bong ker ker/ /grwa gzhon rgyags pa brang kha ldir ldir/ /skya sar babs na dmod mo 'ur 'ur/ /yul mi gnyen nye mgo bo dud dud/ /

guchinapa'i nga 'o brjeslo ba ma'i ma lo mig chu sham sham/ /stag lo ba zhig mtsho la 'phen 'phen/ /ri tre'os 'gan slob gso 'u lag rgyug rgyug/gung gseng ran dus btson nas thon thon/ /grub mtha'i phyogs ris chu khol gdu gdu/ /mdza' bshes mthun sgril dar ba dkrog dkrog/lung yig rdzun ma brda yig 'grem 'grem/ /dmangs kyi sems pa lu gu rtse rtse/ /sman bcos mang shas phyag nas than thun/ /re ba phal cher bza' btung tag tag/grol dus bsu ba'i yul mi rub rub/ /dus ltar skyel ba'i khyim mi kha kher/ /dmangadu ngaridirungabagangazhigamagu ba'ichedadu/ loreba'inabusnagalobaritshartsanang/༷the /sdubone+erī 'i

mchi pa'i nga 'o brje'achad pa'i phyogs su kha lce dig dig/rtsod pa'i thad la smra brjod ldab ldib/ /rtsom pa'i tshe na dran shes tham thom/ /blun po skor zhig glang thug 'gying 'gying / /zhi khro'i lha tshogs gser tshon kyug kyug/slob khang sgo sam skya mdog thal thal/ /rnga spug chos dung sing sing snyan snyan/ /slob bu'i sbyor klog chad chad mthud mthud/ /lha khang spub ston 'a 'ur zang zing / /dge rgan dus chen gakhu sim sim/ /pha ma'i dmigs bya rgyu nor rdog rdog/phru gu'i sbyangs 'bras bya sgong log log/

mchi pa'i nga 'o brjesku rim cho ga me tog bkad bkad/ /slob byol slo ba ma sprang ma 'phur 'phur/ /gnas skor mjal ba sha khyu zhogs zhogs / /gseng na slob phrug she'u chung lding lding / /dpe cha sna ring gces nor nyar nyar/ /mchod sgam nang na spos dri thul thul/ /slob khrid sbyangs deb pags pa nyed nyed/ /mi gtsang phyags bdar khrod na hral hrul/ /a lags mthon po'i khri na rdzig dzig/sgor mo skyu ru leb mo rtseg rtseg/slob dpon mi dmangs mtha' na zhum zhum/ /slob grwa'i dom yig bu yug 'tshub 'tshub/ /

mchi pa'i nga 'o brje ri gsu ma rtse na dar lcog lhab lhub/ /nyag gsum khis na lab rtse krong krong / /lung gsum mdo yi khang rnying thar thor/ /bca' sdod slob grwa yin pa skyo skyo/ /stod na chos skad snyan mo lhang lhang / /smad na rnga skad brel mo tong tong / /bar na lcags chag rdo bas thag thag/slob khrid tshogs brda yin pa sdug sdug/dgon na chos khrims dar skud 'then 'then/ /grong na sde khrims gru gu sgril sgril/ /nam yang mi grim bal thig lhad lhod/ /slob gso'i sgrig khrims yin pa mtshar mtshar/ /

glen pa rdzog jig1drin pha rgan gyi re ba ri ltar brtsigs shing / /byams ma yum gyi 'dun pa mtsho bzhin bskyil nas/ /dpal shes bya yi phyogs su 'bungs par bskul te/ /bu chos log ni yon tan bslab tu brdzangs byung / /rgan mthong tshad la a khu dge rgan zer bas/ /mi ya rabs shig red ces kun gyis gleng zhing / /sman ma byan tshor a ce ja mar 'bod pas/ /gzhon tshul ldan zhig 'dug ces yongs kyis bsngags ༈d+ngha 7/ —/

gle pa3jo ltojo2bod shes rig gi nying bcud dbyangs gsal so bzhi/ /mdzangs bshes gnyen gyis lo ngo gsum la khrid mod/ /nag sgo sam gyi ngos su 'bri ru bcug tshe/ /bu ya rabs des yig 'bru gcig kyang mi shes/ /dus rtag tu ni kha chu snabs chu drud nas/ /mi gzhan pa yis brnyas pa zhu gtug byed kyang / /gnyom nyam chung gi slob mar gcar rdung byed pa'i/ /ngan dgu 'dzoms kyi gte bo kho rang yin no/ /skabs 'ga' re la 'dzem med 'khrig gtam smras shing / /mtshams lan rer ni lbu rag lkog 'thung byas pas/ /rang slob grwa 'di'i sgrig lam dkrugs song zer nas/ /rgan slob gtso yis sdigs mo rgyun du gnangs song / /— 78 —

glenapardzi rdzibyams dbe rgan tshos gros mol thengs 'gar byas te kong sde dpon gyi drung du 'phrin zhig bskur nas / bu chos log ni yul nas gtan sdod byos dang / /der slob byol gyi chad pa mi gcod zer ro/ /3pha rgan po yis chu phying rgyab tu bskon cing / /ma bgres mo yis 'ur cha lag tu bzhag nas/ /dbul phyug sgyur gyi thad du 'bad par gdams te/ /bu chos log ni lug khyu 'tsho bar mngags kyang / /lug g.yang dkar ni ri rgyag thang rgyag byas te/ /spyang dar ma yis la bda' lung bda' byas shing / /gnyen yul mi tshor gsang nas lkog tu btsongs pas/ /g.yang sgo zog gi 'phel ka nyung du gud song / /

:sgo rnga 1rje 4rje4yul pha ma yis khog rtsis zhib tu ded de/ /bu gces phrug gis yi ge lo 'gar bslabs pas/ /rang yul tsho yi khrom nas tshong zhig brgyab na/ /brin khe spogs ni cis kyang lon no sems so/ /pho rkyal stong tsho bos nas sho re rtse zhing / /sman 'phyon ma dag bsus te mgron re byed zhor/ /phyug 'byor ldan gyi tshong dpon nga yin zer nas/ /bu mdo med de stong gtam smra bar brel 'dug/dus nyin mtshan du a rag bag med 'thung gin/ /lag sgor rdog 'ga' yod dus grong re 'grims te/ /skyid 'tsho ba yi yang snying 'di yin zhes nas/ /gtam kha pho ni 'brug sgra ldir ldir byas kyang / /— 80 —

gle pa4rje narjesmad dngul khang gi bun bdag khyim du slebs dus/ /sgor khri tsho 'ga'i bu lon 'phrod thabs bral bas/ /drin pha ma yis brang khog rnga bzhin brdungs nas/ /bu nus med der re thag gting nas chad song / /5'brog pho gzhon 'ga' dmag la zhugs pa mthong nas/ /bu chos log kyang ming tho 'god du song yang / /dmag sdud mkhan gyis mig myul thengs 'gar byas te/ /gzugs skye lus ni cung tsam thung 'dug zer ro/ /6gzhi 'khor ba yi dkyil nas a thang chad pa'i/ /bu chos log ni dgon pa'i grwa ba byas te/ /gnad zab mo yi gnas lugs rtogs pa'i tshul gyis / /dad khyim pa tshor‘‘chos bayadami’gang mang brgyabs tshe/ /— 81 —

gle pa4rje sha sku 'ja' lus su brnyes pa grub dbang dam pa'i/ /dpal rnam dag gi yang srid kho red zer nas/ /mchog mkhan chen gyis tshig thag chod pos gsungs pas/ /'brog dad 'bangs tsho mos gus mchi ma 'khrigs song / /7rin gong chen gyi 'jeb 'khor bde mo'i nang du/ /mdzangs shes ldan gyi zol gyis spyan shel mnabs pa'i/ /sku gzi nyams kyis brtas pa'i skyes bu de ni/ /nga'i slob chung gi slob grogs chos log yin no/ /mtshar rngam brjid ni 'bar ba'i khri 'phang steng gi/ /thag nye ring gi mjal bas gus phyag bsgur sa'i/ /mtshan snyan grags ni ldir ba'i mchog sprul de nyid/ /nga'i slob chung gi slob grogs chos log yin no/ /

tsha rmugs/mdangs mdzes g.yu zhun khu ba yis / /lan khrir byugs 'dra'i ne+e'u gsing cher/ /nyin byed zer ma 'gyed drags pas/ /me tog dbu 'phang dud de gnas/ /dkar nag phyugs kyi khyu tshogs kyang / /gzan la yan pa'i sems nyams te/ /mjug ma'i rnga yab g.yo ba kyin du/ /srin bu 'gog pa'i thabs su 'bungs / /chu 'dzin sgrib g.yogs spangs pa yi/ /snang ba'i bdag po sgren bu des/ /mkha' dang chu gter nor gyur nas/ /'khyag sib khrus la 'jug gam ci/ /

zu mi thag/bya lam bas mthar rgyu ba yi/ /rab dkar sprin pa sab sob dag/kha dog gzhan zhig 'chang ba yi /me dpung dgung nas 'bar lags sam/ /bsil ba'i bde ba 'thob pa'i slad/ /chu ru rtsen pa'i gzhon nu'i tshogs/ /dkar mdzes yid sdug ngang mo'i khyu/ /gtsang bo'i ngogs su 'phyo bar 'khrul/ /dud khyim mang bo'i 5/nga steng du/ /du ba'i rgyu ba dben pa ni/ /nyi mas mnar ba'i skyes bu tshos/ /sreg za kun nas spangs par nges/ /— 84 —

zug thag/phyag phreng bgrang ba'i bgres pos kyang / /dge sgrub mdzad pa'i rgyun ba'ag ste/ /lang tshor gyes pa'i lag pa yis / /rngul chu'i thigs pa 'phyid par brel/ /nyi gdugs grogs su bsdongs pa yi/ /gzhon dpal rgyas pa'i gnag skyong mas/ /than thun shugs glu len gyin du/ /bser ma rlung la rgyang 'bod byed/ /dbu rtse dgung du bsnyegs pa yi/ /rngam bajid rdza ri'i phreng tshogs kyang / /gor ma bsregs mas gtses gyur pa/ /phyag sbal khrod kyi gyad mi ba'in/ /

zug tha /tsha bas nyen pa'i rkang drug ni/ /rta bdun zer mas gdungs gyur te/ /'jam brlan 'dab ma'i bsil grib tu/ /dar dir mgrin glu re zhig 'gags/ /gshog zung 'tshig par bred pa yi/ /sgeg ldan phye leb khra bo zhig/sa le sbram gyi mdog 'dzin pa'i/ /gsar skyes sha mo'i 'og tu yibs/ /dbyangs gsal mdzes pa'i dar lcog kyang / /snying nye rlung bur bral gyur pas/ /ma rangs 'khang ba'i skyo nyams kyis/ /mthing srug spra yi sgo khar 'khobs/ /

/tsho tha /'brog khyis hal ba'i dbugs brtsegs nas / /dgung du bltas nas zug pa ni/ /'od kyis snyems pa'i khri gdugs la/ /mche bas rmug par rngam dang mtshungs/ /mkha' lam skyen par gcod pa yi/ /stobs rtsal mnga' ba'i 'dab ldan tshogs/ /rngul chus mjug sgro bangs pa ltar/ /mngon med tshang gi skyibs su gab/ /tsha bas gdung dus gtsang bo chab/ /mu tig bzhin du rab mdzes shing / /lhung lhung 'bab pa'i sgra de yang / /rgyud mangs ltar du snyan pa la/ /

dzing dang zas tho/sgo byang dang zas tho/sma ra tsub mos khebs pa'i ngo gdong smug po/ /pra chal phru gu'i dus dang ring du gyes pas/ / ‘dus bzhi dmar lham khang’’① gi lham de gon na/ /na tshod 'di dang 'gal ba'i zhad cig los yod/ /mi 'dod na tshas gnyid kyi bde ba phrogs pas/ /lha rje dam par bka' 'dri zhu ru song yang / / ‘sman pa'i gzhu las khang ’gi sgo khar thon dus/ /rang srog 'ben la 'jog par zhed snang skyes byung / /tram̐)8ṭ+wāṃsaba'irabrinapa'ilhamartsangakhangazhesab ra'os/

byangadangazasatho/skra lo ring mor byi dor gang legs byas nas/ /pha mar skor zhig brgyab rgyu'i 'char bkod yo da kyang / /‘‘maso ga'ar khang’’gi yi ge rgyang nas mthong dus/ /bde 'tshams ngang nas yul du song na 'dod do/ /dgun slag dron po zhig gi gra sgrig med pas/ /‘‘pho grang 'thung ba'i dpa' gdeng kun nas zhum 'ing / /'khar ba sra mo zhig gi ram 'degs dkon pas/ /‘‘langs min’’za ba'i spobs pa yo ngas su yal song / /'dul khrims ldan pa'i ban chung btsun pa min pas/ /‘‘chos gos spus legs 'tshong sa'i’’sgo them ma brgal/ /sngo tshod tshong khang ga sa gang du yo da pas/ /‘‘dri 'im sgog rdzas khang’mide ched du ma btsal/ /

byang dang zas tho/‘‘ma gro na khang ’nang du gnas tshang bcas na/ /khram pa rkun ma mang bos 'tshe bar dogs shing / /‘‘sgo stag bcu bzhi ba’’yi khang bar 'dzul na/ /rgya stag ngar ma mang bos 'cha' bar skrag go/da ni mang po bshad pa'i khom long mi 'dug/‘‘rta rga shan sami’de nas sga zhig shan rjes/ /‘‘'gyor phyug tshong khang’ nang nas tshong 'ig brgyabs te/ /‘‘'phrod bstan blta sku khang’’gi sku 'drar blta dgos/ /da ni mang po bshad pa'i khom long mi 'dug/‘‘mo tho shig gso byed sa'i’’shig de gcir rjes/ /‘‘so tshab bsgar sar’ song nas so zhig btsugs te/ /‘‘rgyan dwa 'dzi ba'i chem’’nas zas shig bza' dgos/ /②bcu sa:kārdoṭ+wāṃblozhisdiṭīsnyisbyigārmi swārnyitrī pasdeltamid pa'isgobyang dngazasarjokhag cig gidzi'agyur jiba'in du

'dre na po nga larje po/'dre nag po snyong la rje bo/da wagashed 'dul brgyabs pa'i che 'das gig gzu bor gleng ba/shing tsan dan phreng ba mi tshe 'khor mo ru bgrangs paṭasdo /lag mdzub gu'i sen mo mar ngo'i tshes ris bzhin zad song / /skyabs gzhan la re ba'i phyag skor yu na ring du byas pas/ /kāsdu 'a/ tsho/ ba'i bshul lam mu khyud zlum po ru grub — 91 —

'dre po nga latsam po/mdog ser bo'i chos thum kha gang ya phug tu sbas pas /mi ngan pa'i rigs zhes gral rim dgra bo ru btsis myong / /lha'i‘‘lung yig’’hral hrul gnyen nye khyim mtshes tshor bkram pas/ /ru tsho ba'i dkyil nas dgag rgyag 'thab rtsod kyang byas myong / /skya thal ler mchu sgros ser khas shig shig tu khengs kyang / /'od lam mer mchod me nyin mtshan dbyer med du bsgron yod/ /rdul shur rer rang khyim mdzo pho'i sna khung las dog kyang / /— 92 rjirtan brling nger 'bum sku lhun po'i gtos tsam

rngu 'u 25 thapa shā gu lnga /'ig bzhengs yo da/ /sman bu mor sgeg rdzas nyo ba chud zos su rtsi bzhin/ /stod jo bor gser tshon byug pa'i stong bsam zhig sgom zhing / /gzhon bu tshar phrug lwa bzo ba rgyas spros su bsam gyin/ /mchog lha sku'i na bza' brje ba'i re 'dun zhig cibacangs 'dug/sman gong chen dbyar rtswa yang shi yang so sa su rlom nas/ /de 'thu ba'i chung mar bza' 'khon drag po re brgyabs shing / /chu gtsang bo'i gser nya klu yi gdung rgyud du — 93 —

'i dre pas nga shā na cas/brtsis nas/ /de 'dzin pa'i phru gur gcar rdung nan mo re byas myong / /glen sder thogs 'phyi ba'i tshogs kyang sgom chen du bkur nas/ /mtshar yid 'phrog ngag rgyun mang bo dag snang gis brjod cing / /bya 'dab chags gong mo'i khyu yang lha bya ru bskos te/ /snyan rab btags ngag rgyun ring mo dad gus kyis gleng srid/ /lug g.yang dkar sog pa tshig pa'i ri mo la brtags te/ /— 94 sngi bu mo'i lhad med brtse dung me lce yis bsregs

'dre po nga la bo/shing / /rtsis rde'u chung rdog po yar 'jog mar sgul la bltas nas/ /gces phru gu'i rnam dag zhe 'dang brtse med du gtor myong / /g.yang sgo zog mang shas med mug dka' sdug khrod btsongs kyang / /mchog sku lo'i tshe thar rwa kha sprug zing nger gnas shing / /nor gong chen phal cher khe chung brdibs tshong ni brgyabs kyang / /rin gzhal bral thang ga khyim gyi yar stod du bshams yod/ /dge dkar phyogs zhing sar phun tshogs son d+ngha 95 —

'dren po nga la bo/bzang zhig 'debs ched/ /smad dngul khang sgo nas bu lon nam bskyi la bsgugs shing / /ngan nag phyogs ru dpung gzhi nas rmeg med du gzhom ched/ /'brog sdig tshong ba tshor khong khro'i sting tshig kyang smras myong / /kha dmyal bar mi 'khor khas len dam bca' ni yo da ces/ /gzhon sku skye shig gi kyal gtam bden tshig tu bgrangs shing / /tshe phyi mar bla ma nyid las re sa ni med ces/ /py-i/ra/ /snyan mo zhig gi dum bu man ngag tu rlom — 96 —

'dren po nga larje bo/sdug bzod par dka' ba'i nad kyi 'ching zhags las grol ched/ /gyong 'tshab thabs bral ba'i sman gyi rin yon de bsri ched/ /mig mchi ma nyil ler gsol ba shugs drag tu btab nas/ /ske lcebs thag shad ler bar do'i 'phrang lam du zhugs song / /

bar thagaspro skyid lo gsar ni gtong thengs re rer/ /legs skyes blo 'bab re lag tu bzung nas/ /mi drag g.yer chen tsho'i khyim sgo nyul na/ /dpon chung rdzig po zhig nyan yang srid do/ /dbyangs gsal so bzhi la ser sna med par/ /dpe rtags yod med kyi dus deb yongs su/ /chos rje thu bo 'ga'i phrin las bsngags tshe/ /— sdung srid 'khrul med cig yin yang nges so/ /

b.rathasmyu gu'i rtse mo yis me tog gtsags te/ /sku dpon mthon po tsho'i mdzad rjes btus nas/ /rtsom lus sna tshogs kyis lan mang spel na/ /dril bsgrags las khungs su mkho yang thang ngo / /khog na yon tan ni til tsam med kyang / /mgo ru ral ba ni ljid tsam ba'ag ste/ /lha mthong 'dre rig gi kha shom 'then na/ /sngags 'chang gnyan po ru brtsi yang srid do/ /bod kyi slob grwa nas rtsis rig 'khrid skabs/ /bod skad bkol ba yis phan pa med ces/ /phyogs su lhung ba 'gar tshig skyor brgyabs na/ /slob gtso grim po zhig byas kyang chog go/

bar thaskyid la sdug pa yi mi yul 'di ru/ /med thabs med pa yi mi chos dmad de/ /dam pa lha chos zhes thal mo sbyar na/ /ya rabs dad 'bangs su bgrang yang nges so/ /sku skye lo re bzhin khyim du bsus shing / /sku ngor zla re ltar lug re brdzangs nas/ /thabs rtsal sna dgu yis thabs shig btsal na/ /sde dpon bzang bo ru bsko yang thang ngo / /che zog shi ba yi kha grangs gsang nas/ /chung zog 'phel ba yi kha g.yang bsgrags te/ /yul tsho'i dbu khrid kyi thugs dang bstun na/ /tshad ldan drung yig tu 'gyur yang srid do/ /— 100 —

bar tharten bzhengs gsar ba la gter rdzas mkho zhes/ /rgyus med dad ldan gyi ru sde bsnyegs nas/ /dge ba sgrub khul gyis dkor nag bso gas na/ /'byor ldan phyug po zhes smon yang nges so/ /gnyug ma'i pha skad du ga'an skad bsres nas/ /nyag nyog mnyam 'dres kyi gtam zhig bshad na/ /'grog bde gshib bde yi mi 'ig red ces/ /'khos chung yo ga li dag mgu yang thang ngo / /yin yang rang gshis kyi nor bu stor te/ /mnog chung khe phan zhig dmigs bsam med pas/ /gzhan gyis bstod pa yi cho lo mang bo/ /nga dang bar thag ni rgyang du bkyed song / /
seng gi khyad 'phags skra〉ma thag mi/

mi rabs sum/mi rabs gsum/skyed yum/sa steng 'di na drin can mang mod/ /sha 'jam nu ma bsnun pa'i a ma/ /la lung 'jig rten gang du btsal kyang / /rwa ldan ri bong bzhin du dkon no/ /rang nyid/nywa nag sde bar bzhugs pa'i pha mar/ /ja nag gcig gi phan yang ma thogs/ /cha med mi yi yul khams nyul nas/ /ca co'i stong gtam 'chad nga skyo ba/ /sras chung /ca ril 'dra ba'i mgo bo krog krog/cha med mthong dus ngu skad 'dzer 'dzer/ /ja dkar bkyags na lag chung 'dar 'dar/ /nya bda' ltar du brel ba 'tshab 'tshub/ / — 103 —

mtshan bzhudakli zin tho/kun gsal mdza' bor bral ba'i zla gzhon ma'i/ /skyo gdung mchi ma'i thigs phreng bzhur ba'i rgyun/ /ma khogs mkha' lam yangs por thor ba na/ /rgyu skar bye ba'i mtshar sdug cir yang bkra/mun pa'i bla bre nag pos g.yogs pa yi/ /nem ljang spang du phub pa'i mthing smrag sbra/ /char sprin 'thibs pa'i lhun po'i yang rtse ru/ /lhing bar 'gying ba'i 'brong chung dar ma bzhin/ /— 104 —

mtshan ba dkyi zin tho/sgra de'i pho khyim pha dang ming bos bzung / /mo khyim bde mo drin can ma lor dbang / /ka ca thang mar bkram pa'i bar stong de/ /da gdod sman chung 'khum nyal byed sa'i gnas / /nyag phra'i zla 'od 'og tu yid 'ong 'dzum/ /kun da'i gang bu gsar du grol ba ltar/ /bcos min nyams kyis phyug pa de dran na/ /kho bo 'phral mar phyogs der slebs na bsam/ /tshar dkar spu 'jam gseng na sgeg mnyen mchu/ /ri sil dmar chung char gyis bran pa bzhin/ /lang tsho'i dpal gyis snyems pa de bsams tshe /bdag nyid myur bar khyod dang phrad na 'dod/ /— 105 ——

mtsha ba da1) zi tho/lhag par dbugs kyi rgyu ba'i 'degs 'jog khrod/ /dkar zhing mdzes pa'i mkhrang zlum myos bum cha/ /'o mtsho'i rlabs ba'in g.yo ba'i tshul dran dus/ /'dod gdung sems kyi zug rngu bzod par dka'/ /rdo ba 'jong bor ras kyi lwa bskon te/ /de'u khra zas kyi tshab tu sgrig gin du/ /khyod dang lhan du be'u chung 'tshos myong ba'i/ /pra chal 'brog phrug yid du shar e byung / /rab mdzes me tog dkyil du g.yang dkar khyu/ /ba so'i phreng chung ji bzhin gtor nas su/ /snyan 'jebs la gzhas len pa'i rdzi bu de/ /nyid kyi rmi lam klong du 'khor byung ngam/ /— 106 —

mtsha ba dat+pa zin tho/dmar nag khrom gyi zing long g.yo ba'i skabs/ /skyengs pas gzir ba'i zur mig lcags kyu'i rtse/ /gang gi gdong du tshims med 'phen pa yi/ /dungs ldan pho gzhon zhe ru thogs yod dam/ /bcud ldan rkan mar byin pa'i cang shes rta/ /zol med brtse bas sems 'gul thebs pa ltar/ /myur mgyogs bang gi sgo mo cher phye ste/ /bshul lam skya mo'i khugs pa skyen par bcad/ /rlung gi ldog phyogs bsnyegs nas 'jabs na yang / /sgo khyi btsan po'i rdzi gsang ches rno bas/ /g.yas g.yon brag char 'khor ba'i ngar skad kyis/ /snying 'jags mtshan gyi khor yug yo ngas su dkrogs/ /—— 107 —

mtshanab dashā zin tho/lag sgron 'od zer phog pa'i g.yang zog tsho'i/ /mig gi rgyal mo'i ldog 'od 'phro ba ni/ /mun sel mu tig yul 'dir gtor ba 'am /nam mkha'i skar phran sa ru lhung bar mtshungs/ /bgres pos gnyid ma sad kyis skyabs 'gro 'don/ /mchod khri'i steng na mar me lhang nger 'tsher/ /'dun par ngang sgug byed pa'i go rim khrod/ /dus kyi bgrod pa 'di 'ang dal ba la/ /'dod lha'i pho nya phye leb khri phrag gis/ /mchod me'i 'od kyi snang ba bsgribs byas te/ /lus phra sgeg mor 'phrad pa'i go skabs shig/myur ba myur du bstsal na ci ma rung / /

bla sprul 'ga'i skya ris/ka yi 'dra brnyan/klad skogs stong ba'i gtsug tu/ /'ja' tshon khra mo btsugs dus/ /rtsal med hang 'gros byed pa'i/ /pu shud ltag ring dran byung / /kha yi bya spyod/na ning dgon pa'i a lags/ /da lo phru gu'i a pha/ /ci dang gang zhig byas kyang / /gdul bya'i 'gro don yin skad/ /

:gu shā rtsa ci cardotha /ga yi bskyed bun/dkar bo dge ba'i zhing sar/ /sgor rdog stong zhig phul ba/ /sang lor phyir la bskyis na/ /skyed kas phyed ka zin 'dug/ca yi sbyin gtong /bal dkar tshom bus nyos pa'i/ /dril chung sil sgra sing sing / /bdag por gtong phod che zhes/ /g.yang dkar 'ba' sgra dir dir/ /cha yi lung bstan/stod nas gter kha sngog cing / /smad nas bzo grwa skrun skabs/ /khyod kyi bka' bkod ltar du/ /kho tshos lug ra rtsig dgos/ /

:gu shā rtsa ci lha :rdotha /ja yi nang chen/sras po bya lag rgod cing / /gsang yum g.yo 'phrul skyen pas / /ma dag 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs/ /gleng ba bden shos che ba/ /ta yi gnyen tsha/dbus kyi dge bshes yin zer/ /gtsang gi dgon bdag yin zer/ /phar na bsu mkhan med kyang / /tshur na mjal mkhan mang ba/ /tha yi 'jeb 'khor/de snga'i rje btsun mi la/ /g.yag ru'i phu ru shong skad/ /da lta'i dkor gzan tshon po/ /‘‘g.yag mgo'i’’mdo nas mi chud/ / — 11/ —
bla 'a 'i skya ris/mjug mtha'i nges shes/ /rtswa mi shing mi 'di tshor/ /gus phyag lan gcig 'tshal na/ /shug pa lo dgur bdugs kyang / /mnol ba bsang thabs mi 'dug/

cad tsama'adartsa 11 6〉zugi tshad/rta rgan zhig gi yid 'phrog gtam rgyud/lhun po'i zom nas rta khyu gzan la g.yeng / /chibs rta'i rngog ma dar tshon sna lngas brgyan/ /ri bo'i sul nas spyang tshogs khad kyis 'jabs/ /bshul sha dmar za byed pa'i ham sems 'chang / /sder thogs mig thogs gnyis kas g.yu la bsres pas/ /'brog sde zhig gi lhing 'jags har gyis dkrogs/ /gson nyams ldan pa'i gleng mol gsar ba'i dngu nga / /dar lung rna ba'i bzhi mdor bstar du bsgrigs/ /1mgyogs 'gro'i bang rtsal rlung ba'in skyen pa yis / /gcig kyang 'chi ba'i rgya ru ma thogs na/ / 113 —

4 tshad shā stastazu /sprul ba'i sku yi chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs/ /phrin las myur zhes snyim pad snying gar sbyor/ /2gshed ma gtum pos bar do'i 'phrang lam du/ /brdzangs pa chibs rta nyid las ma 'gongs na/ /mar gyur sems can skyob pa'i 'gro don du/ /spyang mor lus sbyin ba/nga ba'i dag snang sgom/ /skyid sdug 'dres ma'i 'jig rten do ra ru/ /lhag pa chibs rta de las ma brgal na/ /rta mgrin dmar bor dgra yis ma tshugs pa'i/ /'char yan gtam gyi rnga bo ches cher rdung / /4'chi bdag zhags nag thebs pa kha shas khrod/ /— 114 d+ngha

40da 'apro tam da/las skal dman pa'i chibs rta tshud gyur na/ /snying rje'i shugs kyis rang srog blos btang ste/ /nyam thag brtse bas bskyabs pa'i rnam thar gleng / /5'jigs rung nyen las grol ba nyung shas khyur/ /stes dbang stabs kyis chibs rta gnas yod na/ /dgra dpung zil gnon cang shes mthu che bas/ /gdul bya bgegs las bsgral pa'i lta tshul 'dzin/ /6ngar rgod spyang mo khros pa'i mche bar nas/ /byol song rtswa gzan gcig kyang ma thar na/ /mi yi 'gal rkyen na tsha bzlog pa'i phyir/ /phyugs kyi god kar bsgyur pa'i sdom tshig 'jog/

srasachung la ched gleng ba/sras chung la ched du gleng ba/'tsho byed mthun rkyen lcags ri khri bskor cing / /tshe srung man ngag btsan rdzong 'bum brtsigs kyang / /'chi bdud dgra dpung gtum po'i ngar lam nas/ /sgyu lus g.yar bo 'jig pa chos nyid yin/ /nam zhig lus zungs stobs kyi bcud nyams te/ /'dus byas mi rtag rjen par ston dgos pas/ /brtse chen byams kyis bskyangs pa mchan gyi bur/ /rjes 'jug sgrub stangs bgro gleng thung tsam bgyi/ /stod kyi sprul sku btsal nas rta ma 'bul/ /smad kyi btsun pa bos nas chos ma 'don/ /stong mchod yin zhes mar khu mer ma sgron/ /n+d+raspya1 rdo sdin zhes 'jim pa'i sku ma dpar/ /

sras chung la ched gleng ba/dad rdzas gshin rdzas gter bdag mdzod bskrun te/ /mi gtsang dkor gyis sbags pa'i sku lo 'gas/ /sga srab tshags su chud pa'i cang shes kyis/ /tshe 'das bsu skyel byed pa ngas mi rlom/ /kha dog dmar ser gos kyis brgyan pa tshos/ /gsung 'bum po ti 'ga' zhig bklags tsam gyis/ /gshin po'i rnam shes rgod sgro rlung khur bzhin/ /dag pa'i zhing du spur ba ngas mi rlom/ /nyam thag be'u chung 'o skal btsan gyis phrogs/ /nyes med g.yang zog 'bri mo skams su bshas/ /bshu gzhog ma rtsa'i snying bo mer bzhus na/ /byin rlabs gzi 'od 'phro ba ngas mi rlom/ /

sdos chung la ched gling ba/sngo ljang 'dzin ma'i bzhin ras khem gyis gtsabs/ /sa 'og srin bu'i sgal tshigs 'jor gyis gtubs/ /dus tshod brlags nas sa sku'i ri spungs kyang / /phan yo na dpal gyis sgeg pa ngas mi rlom/ /gshin chos yin zhes ye ge rdor ma rko/ /nus stobs che zhes yig drug grangs ma gsog/lam bror bsams nas rtsam pa'i gsur ma 'phud/ /rus thal khyer nas lha sa'i gnas ma snyeg/ma rung nag nyes brtsisas pa ri bo'i gtos/ /sra 'thas yig 'bru 'ga' yis gzhom nus na/ /dge sdig zhib mor 'jal ba'i gzu bo'i khrims/ /phyi ma'i 'phrang na yod pa 'phyang mo nyug/sdi 118 —

sras chung la ched gleng ba/sger don kho nar dmigs pa'i ham sems can/ /ma ṇi'i kha grangs ngom nas dgod pa'i tshe/ /ga'an phan las la gzhol ba'i skyes mchog 'ga'/ /bar do'i mthil nas a thang chad kyang srid/ /dbugs kyi rgyu ba 'gags shing drod yal yang / /bzod med bkres ltogs drag pos rab gzir nas/ /me phung dkyil nas thul ba'i rtsam pa'i dri/ /'tsho rten zas su za ba su yis mthong / /khri shor rgyal mo'i snyan pa rgyang du 'phur/ /mtsho mtha'i rtswa thang g.yu yi mdangs la 'khu/ /lte khrag pho sa'i g.yang gi pha sa 'di/ /kho bo'i rus gong bstim sa'i gnas su 'tsham/ /

sras chung la ched gleng ba/yang gcig gson dang byams kyis bskyangs pa'i bu/ /yar nas gson po khrel yod smra bar re/ /mar nas shi bo las ngan zer bar dogs/ /re dogs ngang nas ga'in chos bsgrub pa mtshang / /mi bu gzhan pa lha ru ma bskyed pas/ /shab shub gsol ba 'debs par nga mi dga'/ /skyes mchog rang nyid 'bu ru ma skum pas/ /zhum zhum kum phyag 'tshal bar bdag mi dad/ /khrel ldan bod mi'i rang gshis btsongs ma myong / /'os min o yo'i zlos gar 'khrab ma myong / /gdug tsub khrag gi 'khor lo bskor ma myong / /'chi ba'i skabs su nongs 'gyod skyes don ci/ /— 120 —

tshwa kha ru bsgres pa'i sbal ba/da ming garig pa'i‘‘ba lang gcin 'ga' ’mthongarjes/tshor 'du yi yom 'khyom rba rlabs bzhin 'phyo zhing / /dungs sems kyi snying bo me ri ltar 'bar te/ /ma bslad pa'i chags sdang ma non par 'phyur ba'i/ /rmad byung gi ljags rtsom nor bu las brin pa/ /snyan ngag gi sa chen sems khong nas 'gul bar/ /byi ba dang khyim byas sngon dpag ni nus sam/ /rtogs sad kyi nyi gzhon shar ri nas 'phags skabs/ /thag pa dang tha gus rtod thag ni pher ram/ / — 121 —

tshwa ru baspes pa'i sbas ba/gzhan dbang gi yur bar gya gyu ru drangs pa'i/ /rnyog ma yi chu phran gtsang bo ru rlom na/ /'char yan gyi chu sna phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa'i/ /klung chen gyi bzhur nyams mtshar sdug ni chung ngam/ /bka' bkod kyi dbyu gus ci 'dod du bskul pa'i/ /mgrin bzang gi gom 'gros rta mchog dang mtshungs na/ /na dmar gyi gzhung na glog zhags ltar 'khyug pa'i/ /rkyang chung gi bang myur sgeg nyams ni dben nam/ /snyan ngag pa'i sems 'gyu so sman dang 'dra bar/ /sgrig mkhan gyi rtsol bas phran tsam re btsir na/ /blos bslangs kyi nying khu bdud rtsi ru 'khyil ba'i/ /shes rig gi skal bzang ga dus su smin nam/ /

tshwa ca baspesapa'isbal ba/kha byang re ba'ag nas rtsom 'bri ru bskul tshe/ /tha snyad kyi snyigs ro 'dzem med du spungs na/ /sgo sam gyi zur khar u tshugs kyis 'tshang ba'i/ /slob chung gi phru gur khyad par ni 'dug gam/ /smyug thogs pa'i rtsom gshis ri skyes kyi ri dwags/ /rtsom sgrig pa'i bsam blo'i lcags dra yis bskor tshe/ /grong ba tshos bltas na ltad mo ni che yang / /sgang ba tshos mthong na mtshar bo rang mi 'dug/

sgyu 'phrul gyi mi yul/g.yo sgyu'i spyor bas 'od snang bdag gir bzung / /nyi zer byugs pa'i bcos 'dzum rtag tu dmul/ /khengs dregs sgam rling mgo lcog ldem pa yi/ /dam las shor ba'i 'dre rgod mang 'di ci/ /— 124 —

dpon chung rtsa do /dpon chung zhig gi rtsa don/ro stod sgur tsam sgur tsam ma byas na/ /sku ngo'i g.yang sgo'i nang du ga la shong / /sgyid pa lhom gyin lhom gyin ma song na/ /mthon po go sa'i khri ru ji ltar 'dzegs / /sgal tshigs zhes pa'i mkho ba med pa 'di/ /u tshugs che ba'i pha ma gnyis kyis sprad/ /khra bo sbrul bzhin ldem lhugs ldan srid na/ /mdun lam 'di las yangs par la thang med/ /tshogs pa'i kha phyogs lha la mi mos kyang / /mgo bdag sku dpon chos la dga' ba yis/ /chos dad yod med gzhan gyis dris pa'i tshe/ /'dzum dmul tsam las lan ni ci zhig 'debs/ —/ 125 —

dpo chung rtsa do /chung ba ja kha chang kha tsam nas kyang / /bstun 'os dag dang bstun na dge mtshan mang / /khong gis thur ma 'dzin dus ngas kyang 'dzin/ /sgrog tse'i sgang du bzhag na ngas kyang 'jog/sku nyid bdud rtsir yi ga 'chus pa'i skabs/ /chang skal gtsang 'thung kho bo'i 'gan du grub/ /sa 'khyom gnam yom skyug mer langs pa yang / /bag chags bzang bo 'jog pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /a pha'i slag par lci 'dam 'gos na 'gos/ /'brog pa bgres po'i 'tsho ba rol stangs red/ /dpon po'i na bza'i spu nyag bsal ba na/ /tshegs chung brgyud nas don chen 'grub kyang srid/ /— 126 —

dpo chung rtsa don/sku ngos phyag 'ju gnang rgyu bsnyel gyur na/ /am phrag nang nas phyi ru 'then byas te/ /lag zung dron pos dam du bsdams na yang / /bkur gzo tsam las ngo tshar ga la brtsi/ /rus sam mtshan gyi zur du thob bsdus nas/ /dpon ming gces 'bod byed pa'i gus lugs kyang / /bdag dang bdag lta'i tshul ldan skye bo tshos/ /bsam gzhig yang yang btang nas gsar btod mdzad/ /ya rabs srol ka nam yang mi rtogs par/ /mi bu'i rang gshis zhes par khag bzhag ste/ /mtho la sri zhu med pa'i kla klo tsho'i/ /smra ba mang ba'i kha de thal bas chod/ /

pha yul gyi tha ga ba/bong skya li'i g.yer kha ṭ+wāṃ sgra snyan sil ler/ /tshong khe ba'i rdzu bag gi 'dzum mdangs shig ger/ /khyim sbra gsar 'bubs mkhan ni su yo da zer nas/ /smad thags mkhan gnas 'di ru thog mar lhags byung / /lag myur mgyogs mig 'phrul dang yongs su mtshungs zhes/ /stag shar bas pho khyim nas bstod bsngags mdzad cing / /tshags 'ib pa'i thags dngos ni kun las mchog ces / /mdzes sman shar mo khyim nas mi da smon shor song / /— 128 —

phayul gyi tha ba/pha phyug po'i g.yang sbra ni de tshos btags pas/ /yon kun la mkho ba yi dngul sgor thob cing / /gnyom g.yog po'i sbre'u chung yang kho tshor re bas/ /rin 'ba' skad tser tser gyi ra pho byin song / /smad tshong lam zhol ma yi nyag lam khis na/ /glu than thun len pa yi lag shes pa 'gas/ /sa de nas rgyu nom ni 'tshol ba sla zhes/ /phyugs ra lug bda' bzhin du pha gir bzhud song / /gzhon pra chal 'brog phrug 'gas rtsed ra bsgrigs te/ /rgya thags mkhan nga yin zhes lad mo byed skabs/ /dman de 'drar smon lam ni ma 'debs zer nas/ /yu la pha mas tshig tsub kyis bkag 'gog byas byung / /

༵skulagyitha ba/'phrul lag skyor 'khor lo yi ldir sgra 'ur 'ur/ /gtam sna tshogs gleng mol gyi dgod sgra lhang lhang / /nga'i lag rtsal gzhan pa las khyad du 'phags zhes/ /thags 'thag mkhan gsar bu gnyis yul 'dir slebs byung / /'jam khu lu'i sgye mo 'ga' btsem dgos zer nas/ /che rgan pas yar stod kyi gnas su bos shing / /bal dkar po'i gdan ring zhig 'thag dgos zer nas/ /chung gzhon pas mar zhol gyi phyogs su khrid song / /snyoms gzhung lam bde mo yi dkyogs lam zhig na/ /'gros dal bur bskyod pa yi skyel 'dren yo byad/ /bal pags pa mar phyur gyis byur bur gtams te/ /smad grong rdal chung ba yi phyogs su nur song / /rgyu 'byor bas phongs pa yi sde mi zhig gis/ /'thag lag rtsal slob pa yi sta gon byas tshe/ /— 130 —

pha13la gyi tha ba/nang phu nu'i 'bas 'dren ni ma byed ces te/ /btsan khu bos khro gnyer ni dpral bar bsdus byung / dzudapal bzo las gud pa yi rdzong mkhar 'di ru/ /bal 'khel 'thag bzo grwa 'ig sger gyis bskrun te/ /‘‘rgya che ba'i 'brog phyogs kyi mang tshogs mizer nas/ /dman lag g.yog 'tshol ba yi brda yig sbyar tshe/ /sngon de snga'i tha ga ba nyam chung de nyid/ /dus da lta bzo grwa 'di'i dpon por gyur pas / /mi'i las dbang zer ba ni dpog par dka' zhes/ /gnyen yul mis u tshugs kyi mgo bo g.yugs byung / /

'a la da 'a ba'i65tsha mo/'khrol dka' ba'i mtshan mo/zla ba sprin pas gcud nas/ /shi 'phag ro 'phag byed gi /skar ma sbyin sreg byas te/ /gnam la me btsa' 'jog gi /skar mda' rnga ma shad ler/ /dgung nas mtha' zhogs brgyab dus/ /dgu tshigs skya mo 'thibs nas/ /mkha' lam rab rib bzo gi /'ur 'ur rlung bu'i gseng na/ /smin drug rkang 'khob lag 'khob/ /lang long smag gi khrod na/ /d+ngha 132sme— bdun phar 'khyom tshur yom/ /

la da 'a ba'imatshanamo a phas mthing smrag sbra sgo/ /khab ring zhig gis mnan te/ /byang skar a brtan zer nas/ /bcol dam 'di ltar gnang gi /dad ldan 'brog pa nga yi/ /sgo zog g.yag rgan gwa tho/ /rgyang du yan par gyar ba/ /'dabs su ga ler skor cig/sa 'di'i jag 'khyam ngan par/ /bya rgod sgyid 'ching rgyob cig/gnas 'di'i ri spyang ltogs par/ /nag chung dmu gab khobs shig/
