la da 'a ba'i mtshanamo/rkun mas 'gas nag btab na/ /zhags sna mthu yis sgyur dgos/ /'phar ba gzhug nas 'jabs na/ /khyed kyis mgon skyabs gnang dgos/ /skar phran bstan bshig tsha po/ /'dzum chung dmul dmul bzhad tshe/ /sgo khyi yi thang chad nas/ /ngu zug brag char stem gi /pha ri'i spyang mo 'ga' yis/ /'jigs rung nga ro sgrog gi /blang dor blo mig ldongs pa'i/ /gzan zhig mthong ni los yin/ /

'a la da 'a ba'i mtsha mo/tshu ri'i 'ug chung zhig gis/ /snying tshims hab dgod rgyag gi /byis sgrung gsar ba zhig gis/ /dgod kha bslangs ni los yin/ /'phur mda' phar 'gro 'ig bes/ /stod nas gzi 'od ngom zhing / /gnam gru tshur yong zhig gis/ /mgo nas gad rgyangs ldir yang / /gti mug gnyid kyis 'thoms te/ /a phas sngur ba 'then skabs/ /bdag gis mig zung bgrad nas/ /nyi gzhon nam 'char sgug yod/ /

dgegan/nam rgyun du dus ltar grags pa'i dril ldan chu tshod cig/pho brang gi rtse ru 'go ba'i them skas brtan po zhig/mi'u thung dag je mthor gtong ba'i shing rkang ring mo zhig/dpon sa yi zur kha nyung ba'i mu khyud zlum po zhig/byis pa tsho'i gseng nas zag pa'i dbugs sgang khra bo zhig/skar ma gang sil bur bgo ba'i gnyer ba zhib mo zhig/sa rdul gyis son 'debs byed pa'i zhing ba tshegs yang zhig/'gig1 ṭ+wāṃḍitram̐ dang 'phyugs rtags mang ba'i rtsis tho mthug po zhig/

tshod zud/ngo bstod kyis sngon du phud pa'i dpa' rtul ngar ma zhig/'od snang khrod dmar mchod byed pa 'i me lceb ljang gu zhig/rang don du brkyangs phyag 'tshal sa'i dbyar rtswa dgun 'bu 'ig/lam 'gro bas phyi mig mi slog rdo zam zad po zhig/shes rig gi dpal yon spel ba'i sa snyug phra mo zhig/zin tho ru 'god rin med pa'i srin bu me 'khyer zhig/mi drag dang sku drag rnam pa'i lam yig leb mo 'ig/smag mun gyi khrod na ba'ad pa'i khrag na tshe 'bar 'ig/—— 1ru)7 —

smag nag chung klad la 'thibs dus/'jam mnyen mi lam gyi dum bu zhib tshags su sel nas/ /gces srog dmar chung gi phang los srad bu 'ga' bsgrims te/ /༵ṭ+wāṃg/ si/ ba chab rom gyi gas hrug snye nang du 'chu yid 'ong snying sdug mar lag shubs dron po zhig bzo 'dod/ /— 138 —

za na chung klad la 'jibs sa/'char yan lha sgrung gi za 'og gang 'dod du dras nas/ /sus kyang mi mthong ba'i zhwa chung mtshar bo 'ig btsems te/ /skyo sdug ngal dub kyi gdung bas bar med du gzir ba'i/ /chung 'dris zhe mthun ma khrid nas rgyang ring la 'bro 'dod/ /sman chen spar rgan gang gcud pa'i sha rdog cig 'phangs nas/ /sgo khyi btsan po tsho'i rnam rig tham thom du btang ste/ /bgres song gtum po gnyis gnyid pa'i go skabs dang bstun nas/ /mo lwa cha yod de'i rum du ldem myur gyis 'dzul 139 ——

'dod/ /tshes ris zad po de zla ba'i ri bong la bstad nas/ /smin drug khra mo yi lcag tshan bar snang du 'phyar gyin/ /sems mthun mdza' na mo pang du bde lhod kyis bzung ste/ /btsan dbang gnyen rtags dang bral ba'i lha yul du 'phur 'dod/ /sprin pa dkar ser gyi tshom bus khul zho 'ig bzos te/ /dgu tshigs skya mo yi khugs pas ong gdan 'ga' gtsags nas/ /d+ngha 140dpar gsal 'jig rten gyi sku mgron ma 'ongs

sma na chungaklad la 'thibs sa/pa'i phru gur/ /dga' skyid spro snang gis khengs pa'i gzim mal zhig skrun 'dod/ /shes bya'i me son gyi dpal 'bar mkha' dbyings su bsgrengs nas/ /mun nag kla klo yi snyigs ma shul med du bsregs te/ /pho mchog mo dman gyis bslad pa'i phyugs skyong ma'i sems su/ /rang dbang brtson len gyi skya rengs gsar ba zhig bzheng 'dod/ /sdeb legs lhu 'grig gi tshig 'bru btso ma yis brgyan pa'i/ /dungs zhen dri bsung gis khyab pa'i snyan ngadzi 1 1 —

sma na chung②dal 'dzibs sa/'ga' brtsams te/ /gnyug ma'i la ga'as kyi dbyangs rta'i 'gyur khugs su drangs nas/ /gshis 'jam zhe 'grogs mar yang bzlas bskyar bzlas kyis len 'dod/ /dkar gtsang g.yang ṭi yis grub pa'i brag ri yi ngos su/ /'ur cha sked pa ru bcings pa'i sgeg mo zhig brkos te/ /rje btsun 'phags ma yi rtogs brjod gsar ba zhig bris nas/ /sgrol ma nyam chung de'i 'gal rkyen phyogs bzhi ru sgrog 'dod/ /— 142dran gdung 'khreng zhen gyi gzungs sngags

sma na chung rmad la 'jibs sa/mtshams med du zlo bzhin/ /lhan 'dzoms skal bzang bis stongs pa'i gzhon nu mar 'phrad ched/ /bgrang 'das ri lung gi bshul lam skad cis la gcod pa'i/ /mkha' lding gshog khyim gyis spu da pa'i stong bas ma du 'byams song / /

rang yul las 'phrosapa/mi khri stong grangs med kyis mjal skor byed dus/ /zhe brel mos rang 'khri yi las kar 'bad de/ /'gangs mchog gyur dus tshod la brtsi bkur gnang mkhan/ /nga'i skyes sa skyes yul na du tsam yod dam/ /gos ser bos brgyan pa yi mi drag sku drag/lu hral hrul gon pa yi mi skya pho mo/ /bzang rab zhan dbyer med du gcig par bgrangs pa/ /rdasdo 4lhasngi sa skyes yul na du tsam yod dam/ /

rangamul las 'azasapa/mchog rang gshis gad snyigs kyi gras su brdzangs nas/ /bdud sdig to'i rnga ma ni dar gyis btums te/ /lha'i khri 'phang gong ma na lhug ger 'dug mkhan/ /nga'i skyes sa skyes yul na du tsam yod dam/ /dpal rmad byung bden don gyi rgyab nas bzhengs te/ /drod tsha rlabs 'phyur ba yi dmyal slang kha nas/ /skyon nyes med be sang tshor dkar 'don gnang mkhan/ /nga'i skyes sa skyes yul na du tsam yod dam/ /dbul mug skyob bsten pa de ngo tshar brtsis nas/ /tshegs ngal ba chen po yi lham 'tshem yin yang / /zas rang gis 'tshol ba yi spobs sems 'chang mkhan/ /nga'i skyes sa skyes yul na du tsam yod dam/ /

rang༄tsholasa'ablosapasnyan ngag rgyun ban bun gyi smug pa'i dkyil nas/ /don ngo ma'i lo rgyus kyi ri rtse mthong ste/ /blun rjes lus 'byung rkyen ni zhib tu rjod mkhan/ /nga'i skyes sa skyes yul na du tsam yod dam/ /gtam nyag nyog brin pa yi khor yug cig nas/ /gtsang rnam dag pha skad kyis go brda sprad de/ /rin gzhal bral gces nor 'di'i gong thang rtogs mkhan/ /nga'i skyes sa skyes yul na du tsam yod dam/ /dngul sgor mo rtseg ma zhig g.yon nas bshams shing / /bden dwangs gtsang gsha' ma zhig g.yas su bstar dus/ /blo sems thag chod po yis g.yas su bgrod mkhan/ /nga'i skyes sa skyes yul na du tsam yod dam/ /

rangaskul las 'azas pa/bu bus phrug shes rig gi slob chung 'grim dus / /rtsis grangs ka gzhan rigs kyi skad chas khrid na/ /brda go ba 'phrod dka' zhes drang gtam rjod mkhan/ /nga'i skyes sa skyes yul na du tsam yod dam/ /sngon pha mes gong ma yi lugs srol bsgyur te/ /khe 'gran rtsod rgod pa yi tshong rar zhugs nas/ /nor longs spyod klu dbang gi mdzod du skrun mkhan/ /nga'i skyes sa skyes yul na du tsam yod dam/ /mchog yang sprul dam pa 'ga'i spyi bo'i gtsug tu/ /mtshar yid 'phrog 'od gor gyis brgyan 'dug zer skabs / /bdag som nyi skyes so zhes rang tshugs thub mkhan/ /nga'i skyes sa skyes yu la na du tsam yod dam/ /

bu bad 'a 'a/bun bdag 'ga'/rgyal khrims nor bu ke ta ka yal bar dor ba'i ham can 'gas/ /bse rag za 'dre 'gong bo'i kha dmangs kyi phyogs su cher gdangs te/ /gong nas gnang ba'i thob tham ga skog rngan len par 'khol gyin du/ /gzhung dngul 'dzin pa'i a pho nga kun las khyad du 'phags zhes gleng / /— 148 —

ngag gi rlabs phreng /001me tog zil ba shig ger/ /bung ba bsams nas ngu dus/ /mo gzhon spyan chab sham mer/ /o lo dran nas bshums sam/ /002mdzes mar khrom chen dkyil nas/ /zur mig 'phen bsam med kyang / /mjing ba'i 'khor stangs shig gis/ /mgo bor rang dbang mi 'dug/

nga rā bas phrengaka003ya gi'i dgung sngon gnam na/ /khrung khrung cha dang cha red/ /'dab chags bya zhig yin yang / /skyid ni ci 'dra'i skyid pa/ /004yid sems shor ba'i mi la/ /spyan mig ya gcig med kyang / /ya gcig de yi cha ga/de 'dra'i yid du 'ong ba/ /005dkar 'jam shog bu'i ngos su/ /sgrol ma'i sku zhig bris dus/ /smyu gu'i 'khyug stangs shig gis/ /byams pa'i zhal ras phab 'dug/— 150 —

006'u gu gnyis ka'i brtse ba/ /rang byon rdo yi ri mo/ /rdo ba hrug ger bcags kyang / /ri mo shag ger babs yod/ /007mkha' yi rgyu skar khra mo/ /mdzangs ma'i lug khyu yin na/ /dgu tshigs skya mo'i klong nas/ /'tsho skyong nga yis byas chog/008mdza' 'azin nya mor bskur pa/ /ol gong brdol nas bor song / /skyogs chung nang du bcus na/ /byams pa'i lag tu gzhag rogs/ /

nga blabs zengaka009tsher ma rnon po'i gseb kyi/ /ri sil star bu dmar chung / /btogs na lag pa tsha yang / /mthong na 'gram chu ldang ba/ /010gzhon pa'i lang tsho'i dus skabs/ /dbyar zla bzhin du thung yang / /g.yo lhad med pa'i brtse dung / /me tog ltar tu mdzes pa/ /lo dang zla shā~X 'khor skyod/ /phreng rdog brgya dang brgyad red/ /khyod dang mthun pa'i nyin mo/ /ba so'i phreng dpon de red/ /— 152 —

012nga ni byams par bral dus/ /dbyar zla drug pa yin yang / /kha ba sems su babs nas/ /byang khog 'khyag gis bsdams song / /013kho tsho ri spyang sngon mos/ /ri nas so lta byas kyang / /nged tsho g.yang dkar lu gus/ /shod nas sngo rtswa za dgos/ /014mdza' 'phrin yi ge nag chung / /ngag gis klog ni mi dgos/ /lag pas thengs gsum reg tsang / /snying gi 'phar lding tshor yong / /

015khyod ni mar me tshe 'bar/ /nga ni srin bu me lceb/ /drod dang 'od kyi ched du/ /lang tsho'i mchod pa phul chog/016me tog dkar dmar cha gcig/chu mo'i 'gram na bzhad yod/ /skyin thang ser ba drag pos/ /thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs rogs/ /017bu mo khyod kyisnrun chab/ /gdong la mu tig phrul phul/ /bu chung nga yi mig chu/ /snying la tsher ma zug zug/— 154 —

nga tsābs zengadi018dung zla'i 'od zer ngogs na/ /lug chung tsha ru'i nang na/ /snying sdug dungs sems can mas/ /gnyid yur rgyag gin sgug yod/ /019lcang ma kher skyes rtse yi/ /bye'u chung mtheb rdog 'dra ba/ /gcig nyid gcig la brten pa'i/ /de 'dra'i gnas bzod bde ba/ /020sang zhogs char ba babs na/ /char gdugs 'dzin pa ma gnang / /snying nye dran pa'i mchi ma/ /char ba'i nang du sim yod/ /

021bu mo'i rmi lam nang du/ /'dzul ba'i rang dbang yod na/ /btsan dang dbang la g.yol nas/snying gi tshig gsum gleng 'dod/ /022khab de rgya khab phra mo'i/ /rtse mo nyis mtshes yin na/ /'tshem bzo gnang ba'i a jor/ /ngan khag 'gel ba ma gnang / /023sman shar nor dad can ma/ /gzeb tu tshud pa'i bye'u chung / /gshog zung ci yin dris par/ /mkho med khur bo red zer/ /— 156 —

nga cesabs brang/dro 'jam rnyi ༵da ngogs kyi/ /'gro rogs grib ma nag ring / /'khyag bsil grib so bkug dus/ /ga sa gang du bros sam/ /mi pho khyod rnyi~X bshad pa'i/ /tshig gsum skad cha snyan mo/ /kyo ba rnon po'i rtse yi/ /sha rdog de dang 'dra ba/ /026sman chung ham sems can mas/ /nyi ma zla ba gnyis ka/bang ba'i nang du shong na/ /lde mig mos nyar zer ro/ /

nga 7bas zeng/027pho gzhon mo la chags nas/ /lam thag ring bar ma 'dzems/ /mo gzhon mi khar skrag nas/ /sgo khyi steng du rbad byung / /028dkar bo dkar gtsang yin na/ /nag nog bsgos kyang srid mod/ /nag po nag rkyang zhig gis/ /ma nyes kha g.yogs ma byed/ /029bdag sems khyod la gtad pa/ /bye'u chung tsher mgor babs 'dra/ /tsher mar gdug tsub che bas/ /gshog par zug rngu bslangs song / /— 158 —

nga 7bas zeng /030bum pa'i nang gi me tog/thugs dogs gnang don ci yod/ /sbrang rtsi gsog pa'i bung ba/ /khyod sar 'khor ni mi srid/ /031bdag gi snying gtam tshig gsum/ /bser ma rlung gis khyer ram/ /bshad ni khyod la bshad kyang / /go ni kun gyis go song / /032chung 'dris phye ma leb tse/ /mdzes ni mdzes po 'dug ste/ /mi kha'i rlung bu g.yugs dus/ /'phur ba'i gshog rtsal gnyom pa/ /

nga rlabs zeng3033gzeb chung dngul gyis bzos kyang / /bye'u chung dga' po mi 'dug/lcags kyu gser gyis grub kyang / /nya mo smon pa mi 'chor/ /034ltas ngan bong rgan skya bor/ /gser sga lhu bzhi bstad nas/ /cang shes rta mchog cig la/ /rang 'thag skor du bcug byung / /035blo gtad med pa'i mdza' mos/ /bdag dang rdo ba brjes song / /g.yu byur rgyan cha btags nas/ /ma 'dris khyo bo bsnyegs song / /— 160 —

nga rwabs phreng/036sman du ma btus gong la/ /me tog tsad kyis bskams song / /khyim du ma bsus gong la/ /chung 'dris gzhan gyis bslus song / /037sman chung smin legs lus phra/ /mig la mdzes po 'dug kyang / /spyod pa tshul 'chos khral khrul/ /sems su 'bab po mi 'dug/038nya mo gcer bu zhig la/ /na bza' skon rgyu ma zer/ /pho hreng yi chad cig la/ /snying nye sgrig rgyu ma zer/ /

nga rlabs zengaka039nga yis btsal ba'i snying grogs/ /sha ba'i mgo yi rwa co/ /skyid pa'i grogs su ma song / /sdug pa'i gshed du gyur song / /040mi dran dgu dran byas nas/ /rta dang bong bu bshibs song / /bong bur ngo so yod kyang / /rta phos gtam ngan bzhag song / /041zla bas ri bong pang 'dug/skar mas skar mar bltas 'dug/snying nye nyid dang bral bas/ /nga ni grogs d+mad hreng hreng / /— 162 —

nga rlabasaphreng 042bu mo chu khar slebs dus/ /nya mos 'khyug 'gros brgyab na/ /gser mdog khrab ris ngos su/ /o lo'i gsang 'phrin bskungs yo da/ /043nyi 'od ser bo bkug nas/ /'od kyi gdu bu bzos te/ /zhe sems mthun pa'i byams par/ /skyes su phul na bsams byung / /044myur mgyogs dus kyi bgrod pa/ /phyi ru bsnur thabs yod na/ /mi lo stong gi yun la/ /nga dang byams pa 'grog chog/

nga zlobs zengad045g.yu chung rdo la gtsubs na/ /rdzus min phu thag chod kyang / /bu mo'i tshig gsum snyan mo/ /ci dang gang la brdar dgos/ /046tshes gsum tshes ris gug por/ /dgu tshigs yu ba srud nas/ /lo yag snye ma 'breg pa'i/ /mdzangs mar ram 'degs byed 'dod/ /me tog 'asdoshā 7ma mnyen zhing / /sbrang bu'i gshog pa srab pas/ /ston sum ba mo'i kha nas/ /nam zla 'khyol bar dka' 'o/ /

nga r+ṇabs phreng/048chu mo 'khyag gis bsdams song / /nya mo btson du tshud song / /brtse ldan dbyar zla drug pas/ /ma 'gyangs phyi skor brgyab rogs/ /049sprin pa dkar bo'i ngos su/ /'ja' tshon khra mo gtsags nas/ /yid sems skyo ba'i 'phrin pa/ /rgyang du bskur na bsams byung / /050skra yi kha dog 'gyur zhing / /so yi phreng ba thor yang / /brtse dung ri glu snyan mo/ /sems nas brjed ni mi srid/ /

nga rlabasaphreng/051bdag gi yid mthun byams pa'i/ /mdzes pa'i bzhin la cer te/ /zla ba'i zhal ras rid song / /smin drug ske tshigs 'khyogs song / /052gson bral byung ba'i snying nye/ /kha ba'i steng gi bye'u chung / /rgum bu gangs kyis mnan pa'i/ /sdug bsngal sems su zug yod/ /053chu mo chu ris shig shig/nya mo gser 'od lam lam/ /chu dang nya mo bzhin du/ /'grog rgyu bshib rgyu byung na/ /— 166 —

054snying sdug dga' mar gyes pa'i/ /dran gdung sdug bsngal lci mo/ /sra 'thas lcags la spar kyang / /ser ga hrug ger gas srid/ /055gor ma rdo yi 'og nas/ /ljang chung 'bus pa bzhin du/ /btsan dang mi kha'i bar nas/ /'u gnyis mthun thabs byas chog/056ri na ri bo'i dar lcog/chu la chu mo'i zam pa/ /sman chung lang tshos brtas par/ /o los bdag po brgyab 'dod/ /

nga rlabs zeng /057kha sems mthun pa'i grogs dang / /lhan 'dzom skal ba ldan na/ /chu 'khyag chang du sgom nas/ /gsum sgron mnyes dag zhus chog/058spang du 'dab rgya grol ba'i/ /gam gyi me tog bzhag nas/ /dgung na kha dog bkra ba'i/ /rgyang gi 'ja' tshon ma bsam/ /059sbrang chung gzhon pa'i lus la/ /ser rdog mda' las btsan pa/ /nyam chung snying nye'i phyogs su/ /mi kha me bzhin tsha ba/ /— 168 —

nga rlabs phreng /060sems pa phyi gtsang nang gtsang / /dri med shel gyi sgo nga / /khyed kyi phyag tu ba'ag na/ /rdo ru rdob pa ma gnang / /061snying nye 'u gu gnyis kas/ /dgung gi skar phran bzhin du/ /mun nag gdug tsub khrod nas/ /brtse sems 'od du sbar chog/062rdo dang ar ka bsres nas/ /yid 'phrog lha khang 'grub na/ /sems dang sems pa 'dres na/ /mdza' mthun snying nye los yong / / —— 169 —

nga rwabs zeng /063pho gral g.yon nas bsgrigs shing / /mo gral g.yas nas bsgrigs kyang / /snying nye med pa'i khrom pa'i/ /glu skad snyan po mi 'dug/064nya gang zla bar dga' yang / /ri bong grib mar sun na/ /'di gnyis kha khar gtong ba'i/ /thabs shig rnyed pa mi 'dug/065sman shar rgyan chas brgyan kyang / /tshe gang gtan grogs med na/ /gser rtsi lan dgur byugs pa'i/ /'jim pa'i sku dang ci khyad/ /— 170 —

nga rlabs zeng /066chu mo dwangs gsal mu tig/chu skyogs kha chag dgu ral/ /ma 'dris mthun khul byas dus/ /nya mo gad mo shor song / /067lcags mkhar sgo med cig gis/ /'u gnyis kha khar btang yang / /blos thub sems pa gnyis ka /rno gcod sta rer sprul chog/068kha ba 'bab thengs re rer/ /sa gzhi'i ljan ljin g.yog 'gro/ /byams par phrad thengs re rer/ /sems kyi kha ba zhu 'gro/ /

nga 45bas preng /069dkar yol dkar gtsang yin na/ /ri mo med kyang phab chog/bu mo'i ngang rgyud drang na/ /dungs pa'i gzhas shig btang chog/070nya gang 'od dkar bsam nas/ /mar ngo yin par ma sdug/brtse 'dang sems su nyar nas/ /sa thag ring bar ma skyo/ /071nas chang sngon mo'i bzi kha/ /lus su phog pa'i steng du/ /na chung bu mo'i zur mig/sems su bsnun nas bzi thal/ /— 172 —

nga rlabasazeng/072dmyal ba'i lcags sreg thang nas/ /snying nyer 'phrad dbang yod na/ /bde ldan thar lam dkar bo/ /rno lcags rtsig pas khogs shig/073dgung gi skar phran re re/ /nam mkha'i spyan mig yin na/ /rang dbang bral ba'i mi la/ /lan cig gzigs rogs gnongs dang / /074ri bo mtho na mtho zhig/chu mo che na che zhig/'u gu gnyis ka'i bar thag/ri chu stong gis mi chod/ /

nga rlabs zeng /075sman chung lug rdzi bu mo/ /tshig rgyan gzhung la rmongs kyang / /lhad med snying gtam dkar bo/ /snyan ngag khri las lhag pa/ /076bu mo'i brtse sems snyi mo/ /tsha lu ma yi nang snying / /a jos shun pa bshus na/ /gab sa sba yul mi 'dug/077nyi 'od lus su phog kyang / /grib so sems su bkug 'dug/dmar chung sems pa dros pa'i/ /thabs shig stsol rogs gnongs dang / /— 174 —

nga rlabasaphreng/078dungs pa'i sems pa dkar bo/ /rkang mar ba'in du 'dres kyang / /sdang ba'i mi kha nag po/ /tho ba ltar du phyar byung / /079mdzes dang ma mdzes mi 'dug/lang tsho dus kyis gzhom 'gro/ /gshis bzang gzhung rgyud drang na/ /tshe gcig rgyan cha yin no/ /080nga dang snying nye 'grogs dus/ /bza' ba rtsam nag yin yang / /rtsam nag kha ru za bzhin/ /'dzum dkar gdong nas ngom chog/

nga rlabs zeng 081khyod ni rgya shog dkar bo/ /nga ni snag tsha nag po/ /kha dog kha kha yin yang / /mthun pa'i skal ba yod 'gro/082rdza ri brag ri'i gseng nas/ /skyo ba'i gzhas shig blangs dus/ /brag ca rna ru 'khor bas/ /byams pa'i gzhas skad dran byung / /rgod la rgosdo ༵nga yod cing / /glag la glag tshang yod kyang / /snying nye 'u gu gnyis kar/ /'dzom pa'i tshang zhig mi 'dug/— 176 —

084'thung ba'i kha phor nyan na/ /ser ga gas na gas shig/mthun pa'i skal ba ldan na/ /mi kha 'khor na 'khor zhig/085rang dbang bral ba'i byams pa/ /khyim bya dkar lu'i sgo nga / /gshog pa'i 'og tu rum yang / /rum yun de 'dra'i thung ba/ /086sha chang bud med 'dzoms pa'i/ /skyid pa'i mi yul khams nas/ /dag pa'i zhing la drud kyang / /rdog pa rdo la gtad srid/ /

nga rlabs zeng /087sku gegs byung ba'i snying nye/ /nag po 'dre ru skyes kyang / /skrag pa'i snang ba phar zhog/'phrad pa'i re ba 'dug go /088lus po chu shel min pas/ /sems pa mthong thabs mi 'dug/sbyan chab sham sham gtor ba/ /blo brid yin ni min 'gro/089g.yu dang byu ru'i bu gar/ /dar skud tshud pa bzhin du/ /khyod kyi sems pa'i sbrubs su/ /nga rang tshud rgyu byung na/ /— 178 —

nga rlabasaphreng 090khyod dang bral ba'i rjes nas / /skyo grogs chang la bcol yod/ /phran tsam sbrid pa'i dus na/ /en tsam spro ba 'dug go /091snying gi tshi lu bzhus nas/ /brtse ba'i sgron me bsgron yod/ /btsan dbang smag gi phyogs su/ /de 'dra skrag pa ma gnang / /092lham chung ral ba'i ras pas/ /gangs rir gnas skor brgyab na/ /mdzub mo phyid pa'i mi kha/ /gangs kyis theg pa mi 'dug/

nga blabs zeng/093mdzes pa'i snying nye dran na/ /sems pa mthur gyis 'then 'dra/ /skyes pa'i pha ma bsams na/ /rkang ba sgrog la brgyab 'dra/ /094sems pa chags pa'i bu mos/ /shog dkar stong ba bskur kyang / /shog cig zer ba red ces/ /bdag sems dga' bas bzi srid/ /095'dab chagab/ bya lus min yang / /sems par gshog pa thogs nas/ /thug 'phrad dkon pa'i byams par/ /skor ba thengs dgur brgyab yod/ /— 180 —

nga rlabs zeng/096nga dang snying gi nor bu/ /shing tog star ka rdog cig/mi kha'i phyi shun mkhregs kyang / /brtse ba'i nang tshi mngar ba/ /097bu mo khyod rang min na/ /lha mo sa ru babs kyang / /ga ler bzhugs rogs zer nas/ /kho bos rgyang nas g.yol srid/ /098thar pa don du gnyer na/ /snying nye spang dgos smras byung / /'khor ba'i rgya ru tshud kyang / /de ni spong thabs mi 'dug/

nga rlabs zeng /zhe sems sbya kaung 'o ma/ /'dre rgyu bsre rgyu byung na/ /mi kha'i byang tshwa dkar bo/ /'debs 'dod yod na thobs shig/100mtshan mor mdza' mo bsnyegs dus/ /sgo khyi sdang sdigs che bar/ /zla ba gdung sems skyes nas/ /sprin pa'i rgyab nas ngus byung / /101zhe sems chags pa'i mi des/ /sgog pa'i mgrin rgyan bzos kyang / /kha dog ba sor mtshungs zhes/ /gzhan la ngom ngom byed srid/ /— 182 —

nga rlabasazeng/102zla ba kho dang kho 'drar/ /bshib pa'i ham sems mi bcangs/ /skar phran rang dang rang 'drar/ /mdza' ba'i dpung rdang sgrig chog/103glang chen rkyal bshus byas te/ /rkyal bas sbud pa bzos nas/ /byams par mi kha skor mkhan/ /sbrud thengs gcig gis spur 'dod/ /104nya mo chu dang bral tshe/ /gson pa'i thabs shig yod na/ /nga dang snying gi byams pa/ /'bral dgos byung yang chog go /— 183 —

nga rlabs zengaka105nyer dgu'i mun pa nag po/ /de las nag tsam gnongs dang / /btsan pa'i pha mar 'jab nas/ /mdza' ba'i snying nye snyeg dgos/ /106nga dang nga yi byams pa/ /tsan dan thur ma yin na/ /dkar yol 'brug ris kha nas/ /nangs thug dgong thug brgyab chog/— 184 —

medanga'abrelaba'i tam da sa/me dang 'brel ba'i gtam rgyud kha shas/ru thar/ wa phyi gling pa'i ngag rgyun zhig tu/ gna' snga mor me drod kyi bde cib myangs ma myong ba'i 'jig rten gyi yul gru 'dir/ mi bu dag bu yu ga gi 'du 'god khrod na 'dar sig sig gis 'tsho zhing / dmu rgod kyi rtul zhugs bzung nas zas su sha rlon za ba mthong rjes/phu ro me se'u si la bzod glags bral ba'i snying na po skyes te/ lha yul gyi me son brkus nas mi yul du khyer yo nga / rjes su/ lha dbang gis kho rang gson por bkyigs nas bya rgod kyi gzan la 'phangs/ yin na'ang / dus de nas bzung mi yul 'dir mun nag dang grang ngar 'joms pa'i me dpung yod par gyur/rig rtsal bskyar dar gyi bsil rlung dal gyis ldang dus/dbyi tha li'i mtshan nyid rig pa mkhan pi ru'u no nyid kyis skabs der mtshan snyan dang dbang grags che ba'i tho le me gtso byas pa'i‘‘sa'i go la ni 'dzam gling gi lte ba yin’’zhes pa'i gcig— rdosdo 8ñcā rti ba

me dnga'azel ba'i tam da sa/de la dogs slong dang dgag gzhag mdzad pas/ bsam blo rang rkya mi pher ba'i‘‘skyes bu dam pa dag’’ha las hong thor du btang 'ing /mjug mthar ma nyes khag g.yogs kyis kho rang btson du bzung nas gson sreg byas/ chal chil tu mched pa'i me dpung gi rba rlabs drag pos skyes chen de nyid kyi phung bo thal ba'i rdul du brlags chimer+sha na'ang / khong gi bsam blo dang khong gi bden lugs de mi lo du ma'i rjes su sa khyab rdo khyab tu gyur pa red/ji rgya nag gi gong ma chin hri hong gis rgyal khams dbang du — bsdus rjes mi sger gyi bsam blo dang snying stobs mtshon pa'i glegs bam dag bsregs thengs gcig gis med par byas/ dus de nas bzung / me tog mnyam bzhad dang mkhas brgya 'gran gleng gi byis sgrung snum po kho tsho dang rgyang nas rgyang du byer/ bran bsgyur rig gnas dang lta ba gcig chod kyis mi lo brgya phrag du ma 'das rjes/slar yang‘‘rig gsar ’zhes pa'i rlung 'tshub chen po zhig gis skyes chen mang po phyi mar brdzangs shing / glegs bam mang po zhugs la bzhen/ snying nas bzod dka' ba'i blun rmongs 'di'i rngams ci 'ag swā~X6ga tram̐ng rung / glegs bam gyi tshig ro rlung bus khyer nas

me dang 'brel ba'i tam da sa/lo rgyus kyi dur du sbas kyang rung / bsam blo'i me son ni sngar bzhin 'bar nges pa stes dbang ga la yin/de sngon zi ling du sdod pa'i phu bo las na gzhon shes yo na pa yus ce lags kyi〈me dang 'khyags rom〉zhes pa dang mo lu'o nyid kyi ————〈gzhil du med pa'i me lce〉zhes pa'i deb gnyis lag son byung ste zhib tu bklags shing / bsam gzhigs kyi khur po rab dang rim par brtsegs pas nang sems la 'khyom 'gul yang ya nga sbyin/ skumun nag la sun 'byin dang 'od snang la re ltos kyi mig zung gnyom po/ mi gzhis la rgyang 'bod dang rtsis thang la brtsi 'jog byed pa'i sems gzhas phra mo/ bden lugs la yi rang byed cing dogs slong gi snying stobs mnga' ba'i u tshugs thu mo/ 'di dang 'di la sogs pa/ nga tsho dang yang bar thag ci 'dra nye ang / mtho sgang gi gru zur 'di ru gnam gshis kyi ngo gdong tsub cing bu yug gi so kha rgod na'ang me dang 'brel ba'i gtam rgyud 'di dag gis nga'i sems khong gi ches gting rim la gzhil thabs bral ba'i me kha dron mo 'ig gsos byung /dus rabs gnyis kyi bsnol mtsham sa su / rtogasda ༵ k+to pring

me dang 'azel ba'i tam da sa/tshugs thub kyi bsam blo'i mngal las bltams pa'i〈me ro〉zhes pa'i deb chung zhig gi phyi mo lag tu son skabs/ 'brog dgon gyi slob chung zhig tu dge rgan gyi las la gzhol ba'i grogs bsam gtan lags dran byung / mi gshis kyi rin thang dang tshugs thub kyi bsam blo/ dogs slong gi snying stobs dang dgag gzhag gi spobs pa/mi chos ring lugs la bla 'bod shugs drag byed pa'i kho rang 'byams klas pa'i lha chos rig gnas dang rngams mthug pa'i bag chags rnying pa'i khrod 'tsho ba'i grong rdal rdzob po 'di'i mi rnams kyi blo ngor shong re skan/ yang gcig bshad na dad sems dang dungs zhen gyis brtas pa'i ser skya pho mo tshor phog thug bzos rkyen/ mchil zhags dang dmod tshig khri stong gi drag char 'bab kyang srid mod/ ‘‘skran 'bur la reg na zug gzer langs pa chos nyid yin’’(sku zhabs zhogs dung gi tshig)pa nga tshos sngar nas rtogs yod pas/ bden trī ṭ+wāṃlda kyi/ rgyab rtsa ru 'greng ba'i kho rang / nam yang kher rkyang yin 2004lo'i zla4par/
